returnOnInvestedCapital1YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available return on invested capital values derived from every financial report in the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. returnOnInvestedCapital5YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available return on invested capital values derived from every financial report in the stipulated 5 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. For average values with period type Annual/Quarter/Semi-Annual; calculation inputs are sourced from the Annual/Quarter/Semi-Annual reports respectively. Return on Invested Capital is calculated using Net operating profit after tax (TTM) divided by Invested Capital.

revenueToEmployee10YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available revenue to employee values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 10 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Revenue to Employee is calculated using Total Revenue (TTM) divided by Number of Full Time Employees.

revenueToEmployee1YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available revenue to employee values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Revenue to Employee is calculated using Total Revenue (TTM) divided by Number of Full Time Employees.

revenueToEmployee3YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available revenue to employee values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 3 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. revenueToEmployee5YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available revenue to employee values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 5 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. tangibleBookValue3YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available tangible book values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 3 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Tangible Book Value is calculated using total equity minus net intangible assets.

tangibleBookValue5YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available tangible book values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 5 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Tangible Book Value is calculated using total equity minus net intangible assets.

totalAssets1YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available total assets values collected from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Total Assets represents total value of all assets recorded by the company.

totalDebt1YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available total debt values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Total Debt is calculated by summing Long Term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations with Current Debt and Capital Lease Obligations. For Banks and Insurance companies Deposits and Securities sold under Repurchase Agreements are also considered. Furthermore for Banks; Advances and Funds purchased from Central Banks; Bank Acceptances and Other borrowed funds are considered.

totalEquity1YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available total equity values collected from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Total Equity represents equity attributable to stockholders and non-controlling/minority interests.

totalLiabilities1YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available total liabilities values collected from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Total Liabilities represents total value of all liabilities recorded by the company.

totalOperatingProfitLoss5YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available total operating profit/loss values collected from every financial report in the stipulated 5 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. totalRevenue5YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available total revenue values collected from every financial report in the stipulated 5 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. For average values with period type Annual/Quarter/Semi-Annual; calculation inputs are sourced from the Annual/Quarter/Semi-Annual reports respectively. Total Revenue represents sum of all revenues or sales that the company can attribute to operational activities of the business less discounts; sales returns; and allowances.

tradeAccountsReceivableCurrent1YearAvera.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available trade/accounts receivables; current values collected from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Trade/Accounts Receivables; Current represents net value of amount due from customers/clients or other parties; within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer); for goods or services that have been delivered or sold in the normal course of business.

tradeAndOtherPayablesCurrent1YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available trade/other payables; current values collected from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Trade/Other Payables; Current represent sum of all payables owed; due for payment within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

tradeAndOtherReceivablesCurrent1YearAver.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available trade and other receivables; current values collected from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Trade and Other Receivables; Current represents the amount due from customers/clients or other parties; within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer); for goods or services that have been delivered or sold in the normal course of business and/or other receivables.

workingCapital1YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available working capital values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Working Capital is calculated using total current assets minus total current liabilities.

workingCapital3YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available working capital values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 3 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Working Capital is calculated using total current assets minus total current liabilities.

workingCapital5YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available working capital values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 5 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Working Capital is calculated using total current assets minus total current liabilities.

reportPeriodEndDate.description: The standardized report date when the company reports its financial statements. Standardized report date will be either 28 or 29 (February); 30 or 31.

commonEquityBookValuePerShare1YearAverag.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available common equity book value per share values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 1 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Common Equity Book Value Per Share is calculated using common equity book value divided by the company's total shares outstanding as of the financial report period end date.

currencyCode.description: The three-letter ISO Code for the country associated to an holding. Different types of securites apply different country assignment methodologies. The country is derived from the Morningstar Business Country methodology for equity holdings; while it is sourced from third party vendors for non-equity holdings.

dilutedEps5YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available diluted earnings per share (EPS) values collected from every financial report in the stipulated 5 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. For average values with period type Annual/Quarter/Semi-Annual; calculation inputs are sourced from the Annual/Quarter/Semi-Annual reports respectively.

tangibleBookValuePerShare3YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available tangible book value per share values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 3 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Tangible Book Value Per Share is calculated using tangible book value divided by the company's total shares outstanding as of the financial report period end date.

tangibleBookValuePerShare5YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available tangible book value per share values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 5 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Tangible Book Value Per Share is calculated using tangible book value divided by the company's total shares outstanding as of the financial report period end date.

workingCapitalPerShare3YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available working capital per share values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 3 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Working Capital Per Share is calculated using working capital divided by the company's total shares outstanding as of the financial report period end date.

workingCapitalPerShare5YearAverage.description: This data point is calculated by summing all available working capital per share values derived from every financial report (quarterly; semi-annual; annual) between the beginning and ending of the stipulated 5 year period; then dividing by the number of available inputs. Working Capital Per Share is calculated using working capital divided by the company's total shares outstanding as of the financial report period end date.

reportPeriodEndDate.description: The standardized report date when the company reports its financial statements. Standardized report date will be either 28 or 29 (February); 30 or 31.

accessionNumber.description: The US Securities And Exchange Commission (SEC) 18-digit unique identifier assigned automatically to an accepted submission by its filer system. The first 10 digits comprise the Central Index Key (CIK) of the entity submitting the filing. The next 2 digits represent the year. The last series of digits comprise a sequential count of submitted filings from that CIK. The count is usually; but not always; reset to 0 at the start of each calendar year.

accruedExpensesCurrentValue.description: Obligations for goods and services provided to a company for which invoices have not yet been received; reported in the current liabilities section of Balance Sheet. Includes: Accrued programming for media companies

accruedExpensesNonCurrentValue.description: Long term obligations for goods and services provided to a company for which invoices have not yet been received.

accruedExpensesValue.description: Expenses that have occurred but have not yet been paid.

accruedIncomeUnbilledRevenueCostInExcess.description: Income earned by a company from providing a service or selling a product; that is expected to be received within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer); or amount due to a company by customers within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer) as a result of exchanging goods or services on credit; which have not yet been invoiced; or the increased asset resulting from billings on uncompleted contracts that are less than the income earned to date. Includes: Contract assets

Income earned by a company from providing a service or selling a product; but has yet to be received and will not be received within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer); or amount due to a company by customers beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer) as a result of exchanging goods or services on credit; which have not yet been invoiced; or the increased asset resulting from billings on uncompleted contracts that are less than the income earned to date. Includes: Contract assets

accruedIncomeValue.description: Amount that has been earned by the company but not yet recorded in the books. Includes: Accrued Interest Income; income earned on debt securities prior to the coupon payment being received

accruedInterestReceivableCurrentValue.description: Amount of interest earned that is expected to be collected within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).  Includes: Accrued interest.

accruedInterestReceivableValue.description: Amount of interest earned that is expected to be collected.  Includes: Accrued interest.

advanceFromFederalHomeLoanBanksValue.description: Secured loans from the Federal Home Loan Banks which are primarily used to support housing finance and community investment.

availableForSaleFinancialInvestmentsRese.description: Accumulated gains or losses from available for sale financial investments

availableForSaleSecuritiesCurrentValue.description: Debt and equity investments that are purchased with the intent of selling them within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

availableForSaleSecuritiesNonCurrentValu.description: Debt and equity investments that are purchased with the intent of selling them at a point beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

bankAcceptancesValue.description: Written promise for the bank to pay the holder a specific amount of money on a set date in the future.

bankCreditFacilitiesCurrentDebtValue.description: Carrying value of amount due to bank/institution which is repayable within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Include: revolving credit; committed facilities; letters of credit; line of credit; uncommitted facility; revolving loan facility; working capital facility; working capital loan facility; Credit facility; Revolving loan term loans; mortgages/mortgage payable ;etc.

bankCreditFacilitiesNonCurrentValue.description: Carrying value of amount due on credit facilities which include revolving credit; committed facilities; letters of credit; etc.; beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

bankInstitutionalLoansCurrentPortionOfLo.description: Carrying value of amount due to bank/institution within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes : revolving credit; committed facilities; letters of credit; line of credit; uncommitted facility; revolving loan facility; working capital facility; working capital loan facility and Credit facility; Revolving loan; term loans; mortgages/mortgage payable ;etc.

bankInstitutionalLoansNonCurrentValue.description: Carrying value of amount due to bank/institution; beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes : revolving credit; committed facilities; letters of credit; line of credit; uncommitted facility; revolving loan facility; working capital facility; working capital loan facility; Credit facility; Revolving loan; term loans; mortgages/mortgage payable ; etc.

bankInstitutionalLoansValue.description: Interest-bearing instruments that entitle the lender or holder to receive interest payments and the repayment of principal at a specified time.

bankOverdraftCurrentDebtValue.description: Carrying value as of the Balance Sheet date of obligations from bank overdraft facilities due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

bankOverdraftValue.description: Carrying value as of the Balance Sheet date of obligations from bank overdraft facilities (credit granted by the bank when accounts are empty and available balance goes negative).

basicNetAssetValueNavPerShareValue.description: Fees Received For Advisory Or Management Services Value

basicNetAssetValueNavValue.description: Gain Loss On Sale Of Capital Assets Value

biologicalAssetsValue.description: Total net book value of living animals and plants. Calculated using Gross Biological Assets; less Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization of Biological Assets. Includes: Timberland; plantations and livestock.

borrowingsFromAssociatesAndRelatedPartie.description: Debt borrowed from related parties/shareholder which are interest bearing and due to be repaid within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: Subsidiary; Associates; Joint ventures; Directors; Key management personnel; Affiliates; Shareholder; Non controlling Interest and etc.

Carrying value of debt borrowed from related parties/shareholder which are interest bearing and due to be repaid within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: Subsidiary; Associates; Joint ventures; Directors; Key management personnel; Affiliates; Shareholder; Non controlling Interest and etc.

Debt borrowed from related parties/shareholder which is interest bearing and due to be repaid beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: Subsidiary; Associates; Joint ventures; Directors; Key management personnel; Affiliates; Shareholder; Non controlling Interest and etc.

buildingsAndImprovementsValue.description: Cost of buildings owned by the company for its business operations; including improvements associated with the buildings. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

capitalLeaseObligationsCurrentValue.description: Carrying value of obligations arising from finance leases that are due beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: Hire purchase; non-current

capitalLeaseObligationsNonCurrentValue.description: Carrying value of obligations arising from finance leases that are due beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: Hire purchase; non-current

capitalLeaseObligationsValue.description: Total amount of long-term finance leases.

capitalRedemptionValue.description: Reserve created by company for redemption/cancellation/repurchase of preference shares; Equity share/debenture other than treasury shares Include: Capital redemption reserves

capitalReserveValue.description: Amount reserved for long-term capital investment projects or any other large and anticipated expenses that will be incurred in the future.

capitalStockValue.description: Carrying value of stock issued and outstanding by the corporation; including common and preferred stock.

cashAndCashEquivalentsValue.description: Total of all cash and cash equivalents.

cashCashEquivalentsAndShortTermInvestmen.description: Total of all cash; cash equivalents and short term investments.

cashEquivalentsValue.description: Investment which company has reported as cash equivalents. (Marketable securities; certificates of deposit; bankers' acceptances; commercial paper; bank deposits; time deposit; and treasury bills (regardless of maturity).

cashRestrictedOrPledgedCurrentValue.description: Carrying amount of Cash; Cash Equivalents and Short Term Investments items which are restricted as to withdrawal or usage for a period of less than one year or a normal operating cycle. E.g. Restricted deposits; Judicial; pledge deposit; restricted investment; etc.

cashRestrictedOrPledgedNonCurrentValue.description: Carrying amount of Cash; Cash Equivalents and Investment items which are restricted as to withdrawal or usage for a period of more than one year or a normal operating cycle. E.g. Restricted deposits; Judicial; pledge deposit; restricted investment; etc.

cashValue.description: Total of cash on hand and/or in bank. Includes: Demand deposit; cheques; demand draft; cash in transit ; etc.

centralBankAndAgenciesHomeLoanStockValue.description: Stock purchased from federal home loan banks; which support housing finance and community investment.

centralBankFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSo.description: Amount that a bank with insufficient reserves borrows at the central bank rate to meet its reserve requirements and the amount of securities that an institution sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date.

centralBankFundsPurchasedSecuritiesSoldU.description: The aggregate of all funds and securities that a bank borrows at the central bank rate; sells with a repurchase agreement; and loans.

centralBankFundsPurchasedValue.description: Amount borrowed by a bank at the central bank rate to meet its reserve requirements.

centralBankFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchas.description: Sum of central bank funds sold and securities purchased under reverse repurchase agreements.

centralBankFundsSoldSecuritiesPurchasedU.description: Sum of central bank funds sold; securities purchased under reverse repurchase agreements; and securities borrowed.

centralBankFundsSoldValue.description: Short-term loans of immediately available reserve balances at the central bank; to other banks and securities dealers. Usually; the transactions are for one day or overnight lending. Includes: Federal Funds Sold

closingShareholdersFundsValue.description: Balance of shareholders' equity at the end of the period.

commercialPaperValue.description: Carrying value of money-market securities (drafts; checks; and certificates of deposit); issued by large banks and corporations.

commonSharesIssuedValue.description: Number of Common or Ordinary Shares issued as of the period ending date; including both outstanding and treasury shares.

commonSharesOutstandingValue.description: Number of Common or Ordinary Shares outstanding as of the period ending date.

commonSharesTreasuryValue.description: Number of Common or Ordinary Treasury Shares as of the period ending date.

commonStockValue.description: Value of issued common shares of the company.

commonUnitValue.description: Carrying value of limited partners' interest in the partnership; represented by common units that entitle the holders to the rights and privileges specified in the partnership agreement. Each holder of a common unit is entitled to one vote per unit on all matters presented to the limited partners for a vote.

commonUtilityPlantValue.description: Cost of all other plants and facilities not categorized in the above. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

constructionInProgressAndAdvancePayments.description: Costs capitalized for construction in progress and advance payments. Includes: Construction in progress for utility plant; Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

convertibleDebenturesLoansNonCurrentValu.description: Carrying value of long term convertible debt/loans (loans that entitle the lender to convert the loan to common or preferred stock/shares) scheduled to be repaid beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: hybrid debt

convertibleHybridLoansCurrentDebtValue.description: Interest-bearing instruments that entitle the lender or the holder to convert the instrument into either common or preferred stock at a specified conversion rate and within a specified time frame during the current accounting period.

convertibleHybridLoansNonCurrentValue.description: Interest-bearing instruments that entitle the lender or the holder to convert the instrument into either common or preferred stock at a specified conversion rate and within a specified time frame beyond the current accounting period.

convertibleHybridLoansValue.description: Interest-bearing instruments that entitle the lender or the holder to convert the instrument into either common or preferred stock at a specified conversion rate and within a specified time frame.

convertibleLoansDebenturesCurrentPortion.description: Carrying value of long term convertible debt (loans that entitle the lender to convert the loan to common or preferred stock/shares) scheduled to be repaid within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: convertible subordinated debt; hybrid debt

cumulativeForeignExchangeTranslationRese.description: Accumulated gains or losses from foreign currency translation

currentDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationValu.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the Balance Sheet date; of all long-term debt and capital lease obligations that are expected to be repaid within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

currentDebtValue.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the Balance Sheet date; of all short term debt having maturities due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

currentPortionOfLongTermDebtAndCapitalLe.description: Carrying value of the portion of all long-term debt that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer) and all capital lease obligations.

currentPortionOfLongTermDebtValue.description: Carrying value of the portion of all long-term debt that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

customerRelationshipsValue.description: Company's interactions with current and potential customers that have value and economic benefit to the company. Includes: Net book value if accumulated amortization is not reported

datedLoanCapitalValue.description: Type of subordinated debt with a fixed date.

debtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsValue.description: Sum of all debt and capital lease obligations.

debtSecuritiesNonCurrentValue.description: Debt securities the company intends to hold for a period beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

debtSecuritiesOrDebtCertificatesIssuedIn.description: Debt instruments that have basic terms defined; such as notional amount; interest rate and maturity date; and can be bought or sold between two parties.

debtSecuritiesValue.description: Debt securities held by the company.

debtValue.description: Sum of all written promises and/or agreements to repay a stated amount of borrowed funds at a specified date in the future.

deferredCostsAssetsCurrentValue.description: Payments that will be assigned as expenses in the current year or during the current normal operating cycle (whichever is longer); but were paid in advance and temporarily set up as current assets on the balance sheet. Excludes: Deferred Tax Assets

deferredCostsAssetsNonCurrentValue.description: Payments that will be assigned as expenses in the following year or during the next normal operating cycle; but are paid in advance and temporarily set up as non-current assets on the balance sheet.

deferredCostsAssetsValue.description: Costs that have already been incurred but not yet charged as an expense.

deferredIncomeCustomerAdvancesBillingsIn.description: Advances received from customers for goods or services which are yet to be delivered or over billing; where the actual revenues earned are less than the accounts receivable billed; which will be recognized within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: Contract liabilities; Government grant

Advances received from customers for goods or services that will be delivered after one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer); or over billing; where the actual revenues earned are less than the accounts receivable billed. Includes: Contract Liabilities; Government grant

deferredIncomeCustomerAdvancesValue.description: Collections of cash or other assets received prior to meeting the revenue recognition criteria.

deferredLiabilitiesCurrentValue.description: Liabilities/expenses incurred but not accounted for that will be due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

deferredLiabilitiesNonCurrentValue.description: Liabilities/expenses incurred but not accounted for in the current accounting period and temporarily set up as non-current liabilities on the Balance Sheet.

deferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsValue.description: Costs of acquiring new customers that have been capitalized and will be expensed over the term of the respective insurance contracts sold. Allows for more appropriate matching of revenues and expenses.

deferredTaxAssetsCurrentValue.description: Amount representing total taxes paid or carried forward but not yet recognized in the income statement; calculated by taking into account financial reporting standards for book income and the jurisdictional tax authority's rules for taxable income. These are expected to be used or claimed within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

deferredTaxAssetsNonCurrentValue.description: Total taxes paid or carried forward but not yet recognized in the income statement; calculated by taking into account financial reporting standards for book income and the jurisdictional tax authority's rules for taxable income. These are not expected to be used or claimed within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

deferredTaxAssetsValue.description: Taxes paid or carried forward but not yet recognized in the income statement. Calculated by taking into account financial reporting standards for book income and the jurisdictional tax authority's rules for taxable income.

deferredTaxLiabilitiesCurrentValue.description: Tax liability incurred as a result of differences between company's accounting and tax carrying values; anticipated and enacted income tax rate; and estimated taxes payable for the current year; deferred for payment; payable within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: investment tax credits; indirect & direct tax

deferredTaxLiabilitiesNonCurrentValue.description: Tax liability as a result of differences between company's accounting and tax carrying values; anticipated and enacted income tax rate; and estimated taxes payable for the current year; deferred for payment anytime in the future beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: Investment tax credits; direct and indirect tax

deferredTaxLiabilitiesValue.description: Obligations for tax owed but not yet paid. Deferred tax often arises due to differences in accounting standards and tax laws.

depositCertificatesValue.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all short term interest bearing promissory notes issued by the bank. Generally range in maturity from one month to five years and do not allow holders to withdraw without penalty.

depositsAndBalancesAtCentralBanksValue.description: Cash reserves held at the central bank that allow a bank to provide cash on demand.

depositsByBanksAndInstituitionsValue.description: Deposits held by the bank from other banks or institutions.

depositsByCustomersValue.description: Deposits held by the bank from individual customers.

depositsMadeUnderAssumedReinsuranceContr.description: Amount deposited with other institutions in exchange for reinsurance coverage. This is an asset because it is funds to which the company (reinsurer) is entitled to.

depositsOutsideCashAndCashEquivalentsVal.description: Term deposits or other deposits held at a bank or financial institution.

depositsPaidForBusinessAndFixedAssetsNon.description: All deposits except deposit related to capital assets can be tagged here.

depositsReceivedReinsuranceBusinessValue.description: Amount received by the company for accepting a reinsurance contract. This is a liability because the company (ceding insurer) retains the funds as collateral for future obligations of the reinsurer. The ceding insurer shows these amounts as 'deposits retained for reinsurance ceded'.

depositsWithBanksAndOtherFinancialInstit.description: Cash deposits held at banks or other financial institutions.

derivativeAndHedgingLiabilitiesCurrentVa.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative or hedging instruments and which are expected to be extinguished beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

derivativeAndHedgingLiabilitiesNonCurren.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative or hedging instruments and which are expected to be extinguished beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

derivativeAndHedgingLiabilitiesValue.description: Liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative or hedging instruments. Includes: Liabilities Recognized for Fair Value Changes in Portfolio Hedge of Interest Rate Risk (for banks)

derivativeInvestmentAndHedgingAssetsCurr.description: Fair value of all securities whose value is derived from one or more underlying assets and the company intends to hold for a period less than one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Only use when company classifies it as a short term investment.

derivativeInvestmentAndHedgingAssetsNonC.description: Fair value of all securities whose value is derived from one or more underlying assets and the company intends to hold for a period of one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: Hedging Assets

derivativeInvestmentAndHedgingAssetsValu.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all assets accounted for as derivative investments (after the effects of master netting arrangements) and hedging assets (which reduce the risk of adverse price movements in another asset).

dilutedNetAssetValueNavPerShareValue.description: Lease Revenue From Joint Ventures Value

dilutedNetAssetValueNavValue.description: Other Fees Or Expenses Charged Value

discontinuedOperationsLiabilitiesCurrent.description: Liabilities classified as part of discontinued operations in the current liability section of the Balance Sheet.

dividendsPayableCurrentValue.description: Carrying value of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued and outstanding by the company. Includes: Provision for Dividends/Income Distribution; Dividend and Interest on Shareholder's Equity

dividendsPayableValue.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on the company's equity securities.

dividendsProvidedForOrPaidOutToValue.description: Amount of dividends declared related to the current reporting period.

dividendsReceivableCurrentValue.description: Distributions expected from equity and preferred share investments; receivable within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

dividendsReceivableValue.description: Distributions receivable as a result of equity investments in other organizations and institutions.

documentFormType.description: The type of document filed by the company: for instance; 10-K (annual report) or 10-Q (quarterly report)

documentId.description: Morningstar Document Id; a unique and unchanging Morningstar identifier assigned to each document

dueFromBanksValue.description: Short term loans; or receivables due from other banks that yield minimal interest.

dueFromCustomersAcceptanceValue.description: Amount receivable from customers acceptance that are outstanding on the reporting date as reported by the Bank.

electricUtilityPlantValue.description: Cost of all plants and facilities associated with the generation of electricity. Includes: nuclear utility plants; Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

equityAttributableToHoldersOfPerpetualCa.description: Hybrid capital securities that bring together features of both debt and equity; and are perpetual and subordinate to all senior creditors. They have no fixed maturity date and repayment is at the discretion of the issuer.

equityAttributableToParentStockholdersVa.description: Residual interest in the assets of the enterprise that remains after deducting its liabilities attributable to parent stockholders.

equityDividendsValue.description: Dividend payments to equity shareholders issued or announced during the period.

equitySecuritiesSharesNonCurrentValue.description: Equity securities the company intends to hold for a period beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

equitySecuritiesSharesValue.description: Investments in ownership shares of another company or institution.

exchangeAdjustmentsValue.description: Effect of foreign-exchange translation or increase/decrease in foreign-exchange reserves.

financeLeaseReceivableCurrentValue.description: Amount due in relation to capital/finance leases; within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

financeLeaseReceivableNonCurrentValue.description: Amount due in relation to capital/finance leases; after one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

financeLeaseReceivableValue.description: Amount due to the company in relation to finance leases.

financialAssetsDesignatedAsFairValueThro.description: Other Fees Or Expenses Received Value
Patient And Third Party Payers Value

financialInvestmentSecuritiesAvailableFo.description: Carrying value of available-for-sale securities and held-to-maturity securities.
Sum of the carrying values of Available-for-Sale and Held-to-Maturity securities classified as non-current.

financialLiabilitiesCurrentValue.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the Balance Sheet date; of all short term debt; current portion of long term debt; capital lease obligations; derivative and hedging liabilities and other financial liabilities having maturities within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

financialLiabilitiesDesignatedAsFairValu.description: Property Or Asset Management Fees Charged Value

financialLiabilitiesHeldForTradingValue.description: Liabilities held with the intent to trade for short-term profit.

financialLiabilitiesMeasuredAtAmortizedC.description: Financial liabilities carried at amortized cost.

financialLiabilitiesNonCurrentValue.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date; of all long-term debt; capital lease obligations; derivative and hedging liabilities and other financial liabilities having maturities beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

finishedGoodsAndMerchandiseValue.description: Value of merchandise or goods held by the company that are readily available for sale.

fiscalYearEnd.description: The company's fiscal year that it uses to report its financial statements

fixedAssetsRevaluationReserveValue.description: Reserves created by revaluation of assets excluding financial assets

flightFleetVehicleAndRelatedEquipmentVal.description: Cost of all vehicles and equipment associated with transportation that are required for business operations. For example: bicycles; automobiles; motorcycles; trains; boats and aircraft. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

foreclosedAssetsValue.description: Assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings. Includes :  Other Real Estate Owned; Owned Inactive Real Estates; Idle properties.

furnitureFixturesAndOfficeEquipmentValue.description: Cost of the furniture; fixtures and office equipment owned by the company for its business operations. Includes: Computer hardware and software

gainLossFromCashFlowHedgesReservesAccumu.description: Accumulated gains or losses from hedges

generalAllowanceForReceivablesAndWriteOf.description: Value used to recognize that some current accounting receivable items will not be collected in full and to reduce receivables to the value expected to be collected.
A provision/allowance/adjustment to recognize that some non-current accounting receivable items will not be collected in full and to reduce receivables to the value expected to be collected.
General provision to recognize that some receivable items will not be collected in full.

generalPartnerCapitalValue.description: Represents the carrying value of capital held by the general partners.

goodwillTransferValue.description: Transfer of goodwill reported in the changes in shareholders' equity statement.

goodwillValue.description: The excess of the cost of an acquired company over the sum of the fair market value of its identifiable individual assets less the liabilities.

grossBiologicalAssetsValue.description: Assets that are either a living animal or plant; including all livestock such as goats; sheep; cows; buffaloes; calves and fish and plants such as vegetables; crops; vineyards; trees; timberland and fruit orchards.

grossFinanceLeaseReceivableValue.description: Gross amount receivable by the company in relation to leases and hire purchase.

grossGoodwillAndOtherIntangibleAssetsVal.description: Total gross book value of the company's goodwill and other intangible assets.

grossInvestmentPropertiesAndPropertiesHe.description: Total amount paid for investment properties and properties held for development with the intention of generating a return.

grossLoansAndAdvancesValue.description: Sum of all loans and advances before excluding unearned income and loss allowances.

grossMineralPropertyInterestsAndExplorat.description: Amount paid for the right of the owner to exploit; mine and/or produce any or all of the minerals lying below the surface of the property and all costs capitalized for the exploration and evaluation costs of a resource property (e.g. the capitalized costs to find an oil well). includes drilling cost etc.

grossNotesReceivableCurrentValue.description: Gross amount representing the right to receive the principal amounts contained in written promissory notes. Usually it is a written promise from a client or customer to pay a definite amount of money on a specific future date that is within the normal operating cycle.

grossNotesReceivableValue.description: Value of notes receivable prior to making any adjustments or allowances.

grossPropertyPlantAndEquipmentValue.description: Total gross book value of all the tangible assets that are used by a company in its business operations. Includes: Construction grants used as a deduction to the gross book value; net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

grossTradeAccountsReceivableCurrentValue.description: Gross value of amount due from customers/clients or other parties; within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer); for goods or services that have been delivered or sold in the normal course of business.

grossTradeAccountsReceivableValue.description: Amount due from customers or clients for products or services that have been delivered or sold in the normal course of business prior to making any adjustments or allowances.

heldToMaturitySecuritiesCurrentValue.description: Financial or debt investments that a company has made; categorized as held-to-maturity; that will expire at a fixed date within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

heldToMaturitySecuritiesNonCurrentValue.description: Aggregate value of financial or debt securities which are categorized as held-to-maturity; including items previously marked as debt securities; that will expire at a fixed date that is beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: debt securities if holding period not specified

incomeTaxPayableCurrentValue.description: Current liability account which reflects the amount of income taxes due to the federal; state; and local governments.

insuranceBusinessAssetsValue.description: Sum of bank owned life insurance; cash value of life insurance; and other insurance business assets.

insuranceBusinessLiabilitiesValue.description: Liabilities related to the insurance group of a bank.

insuranceContractLiabilitiesReservesValu.description: Sum of unallocated surplus; policy benefits; claims outstanding reserves and unearned premiums reserves. Unlike investment contracts that do not transfer risks; insurance contracts transfer insurance risk (rather than only financial risks).

intangiblesOtherThanGoodwillValue.description: Total gross book value of all Intangibles; excluding goodwill.

interestBearingTimeSavingsDepositsValue.description: Amount of all interest bearing domestic and foreign deposits.

interestPayableCurrentValue.description: Carrying value of interest payable as of the Balance Sheet date. Includes: Accrued interest.

interestPayableValue.description: Carrying value of interest payable as of the Balance Sheet date. Includes: Accrued interest.

inventoriesNonCurrentValue.description: Merchandise bought or produced for resale; or supplies and raw materials purchased for use in revenue producing operations; that are not expected to be turned into cash within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

inventoriesValue.description: Merchandise bought or produced for resale; or supplies and raw materials purchased for use in revenue producing operations; that are expected to be turned into cash within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

inventoryAllowanceAdjustmentsValue.description: Provision/allowance/adjustment to reduce inventory; resulting from factors such as breakage; spoilage; theft and shoplifting. Includes: LIFO reserve and other allowances/adjustments

investmentContractLiabilitiesValue.description: Reserves set aside for investment contract liabilities. Investment contracts are those that do not transfer significant insurance risk from the contract holder to the issuer. They only transfer financial risks and are therefore treated as financial instruments under IFRS. Investment contracts can be participating (unit-linked) or non-participating.

investmentInFinancialAssetsNonCurrentVal.description: Total of all financial asset investments.

investmentInFinancialAssetsValue.description: Sum of all financial investments (trading securities; available-for-sale securities; held-to-maturity securities; etc.).

investmentPropertiesAndPropertiesHeldFor.description: Total amount paid for investment properties and properties held for development with the intention of generating a return; net of accumulated depreciation. This item often belongs to companies that are REITs. Properties held for development represents a property belonging to the company that will undergo development; but the development has not yet happened. Excludes: Investment Properties reported by mining companies and Properties Held for Development by mining companies.

investmentsInAssociatesValue.description: Stock held in companies; for which the reporting company possesses only a minority stake in the ownership of the company. The parent company typically owns 20% to 50% of the voting shares.

investmentsInJointVenturesValue.description: Business arrangement in which two or more parties agree to pool their resources for the purpose of accomplishing a specific task.

investmentsInOtherVenturesUnderEquityMet.description: Other long term equity investments not categorized above.

investmentsInSubsidiariesValue.description: Stock held in companies; for which the reporting company owns more than 50% of the voting stock.

itemsInTheCourseOfCollectionFromOtherBan.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of drafts and bills of exchange that are in transit from other banks.

itemsInTheCourseOfTransmissionToOtherBan.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of drafts and bills of exchange that are in transit to other banks.

landAndImprovementsValue.description: Cost of land owned by the company for its business operations; including improvements associated with the land. Land is generally not depreciated over time. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported. Excludes: Land held for sale (Assets Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations; Non-Current)

leasedPropertyPlantAndEquipmentValue.description: Cost of tangible assets held by the company under a lease arrangement that cannot be delineated under its respective category in the above. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

leaseholdAndImprovementsValue.description: Cost of properties held by the company under a lease arrangement; including improvements made to the property. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

liabilitiesHeldForSaleDiscontinuedOperat.description: Assets or liabilities classified as held for sale. Includes: assets and liabilities associated with discontinued operations held for sale at the Balance Sheet date; costs of completed construction projects associated with pending sale-leaseback transactions; real estate not currently used in operations and the related mortgage notes payable.
Liabilities arising from discontinued operations or liabilities classified as held for sale.

licensesAndRightsValue.description: Licenses or Rights acquired by or granted to the company are entitlements or permissions; enforceable by law; that give the company the ability and/or exclusivity to perform given actions or use specific assets. For example: franchise and government licenses; licensing agreements; broadcast; copyright; development; distribution; environmental; landing; property/land use; solicitation and air/water use rights. Includes: Program rights for media companies; Net book value if accumulated amortization is not reported

lifeInsuranceAssetsValue.description: Life insurance bought and owned by banks.

limitedPartnerCapitalValue.description: Carrying value of shares under the ownership of the limited partners in a publicly traded limited partnership or master limited partnership; which are represented by units that detail various rights including redemption; conversion; liquidation; tax status of distribution per unit; and the sharing in distributions.

lineOfCreditValue.description: Agreement or commitment to make loans up to a specific amount.

loanAndLoanReceivablesValue.description: Amount owed to the company as a result of loans outstanding.

loanLossAllowanceAdjustmentForBanksValue.description: Allowance or adjustment company provided with respect to loans and advances related to bank.

loanLossAllowanceAdjustmentForOtherValue.description: Allowance or adjustment company provided with respect to loans and advances other than bank and trading loan.

loanLossAllowanceAdjustmentForTradingLoa.description: Allowance or adjustment company provided with respect to loans and advances related to trading loan.

loanLossAllowanceAdjustmentValue.description: Provision for the amount needed to absorb any estimated credit losses inherent on the company's loan and lease portfolio. Deducted from the value of gross loans and leases to arrive at the net value.

loansAndAdvancesToBankValue.description: Loans receivable and advances made to another bank.

loansAndAdvancesToCustomerConsumerValue.description: Loans receivable and advances made to a customer or consumer.

loansAndAdvancesToInstitutionsCorporatio.description: Loans receivable and advances made to other financial institutions and corporations. Includes: commercial/ corporate loans

loansAndAdvancesValue.description: The aggregate amount of loans receivable and advances made to banks; institutions; or customers. Includes: mortgages and other loans; which are stated at the lower of cost or market (approximates fair value)

loansHeldForSaleValue.description: Loans receivable that will be sold to other entities; which are stated at the lower of cost or market.

loansInProcessValue.description: Loans that have not been fully disbursed.

loansReceivableCurrentValue.description: Amount owed to the company that is expected to be collected within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

loansReceivableNonCurrentValue.description: Amount owed to the company that is not expected to be collected within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

longTermContractsValue.description: Contracts reported by the company as part of inventory.

longTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationVal.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date; of all long-term debt and capital lease obligations that is expected to be repaid beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

longTermDebtValue.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date; of all long-term debt having maturities due beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

longTermEquityInvestmentsValue.description: Total value of investments held by the company and accounted for under the equity method.

machineryFurnitureAndEquipmentValue.description: Total gross book value of the company's plant; machinery; furniture; vehicles and equipment. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

mortgageLoansValue.description: Loans in which the collateral is a specified piece of real estate that the borrower will pay off over time.

mortgageServiceRightsValue.description: Mortgage service right is a contractual agreement where the right; or rights; to service an existing mortgage are sold by the original lender to another party who; for a fee; performs the various functions required to service mortgages.

naturalGasUtilityPlantValue.description: Cost of all plants and facilities associated with the production and distribution of natural gas; oil; and other. Includes: gas wells and properties to exploit gas or liquefied natural gas sites; net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported. Excludes: oil refineries (Properties)

netIntangibleAssetsValue.description: Total net book value of goodwill and all intangible assets. Calculated using Gross Goodwill and Other Intangible assets; less Accumulated Amortization and Impairments.

netMineralPropertyInterestsAndExploratio.description: Total book value of all Mineral Property Interests and Exploration/Evaluation Assets; net of all Accumulated Amortization. Includes: Intangible assets if it is determined they are mining assets; Mine Development Projects' Capitalized Expenditures.

netProfitLossAttributeToMembersValue.description: Operating profit after accounting for abnormal items; taxes and outside equity interests.

netPropertyPlantAndEquipmentValue.description: Total net book value of all the tangible assets that are used by a company in its business operations. Calculated using Gross Property; Plant and Equipment; less Accumulated Depreciation and Impairment.

netUnrealizedGainLossOnInvestmentsValue.description: The net amount of unrealized gains/losses on investments as of the balance sheet date. Recorded in the equity section under the definition of accumulated comprehensive income/loss.

newShareCapitalValue.description: Issues of additional share capital during the period.

nonControllingMinorityInterestsValue.description: Carrying value of net worth of a subsidiary pertaining to common stock not owned by the controlling company and its consolidated subsidiaries.

nonEquityUnder1YearValue.description: Non-equity investments  under one year are typically debt instruments such as bonds or bank deposits. They are issued by companies; by government agencies and by other entities and typically have the benefit of greater stability. The data point is available only for UK companies with London Stock Exchange listings.

nonInterestBearingBorrowingsCurrentDebtV.description: Borrowings that do not bear any interest and are due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

nonInterestBearingBorrowingsCurrentPorti.description: Carrying value of non-interest borrowings that are due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

nonInterestBearingBorrowingsNonCurrentVa.description: Borrowings that do not bear any interest and are due beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

nonInterestBearingBorrowingsValue.description: Non-interest bearing deposits in other financial institutions.

nonInterestBearingDemandDepositsValue.description: Amount of all non-interest bearing domestic and foreign deposits.

notesPayableCurrentDebtValue.description: Carrying value of the obligation to repay the principal amount contained in a written promissory note; on a specific future date that is within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes : Banker's acceptance and Debenture

notesPayablesNonCurrentValue.description: Carrying value of the obligation to repay the principal amount contained in a written promissory note; on a specific future date that is beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes : Banker's acceptance and Debenture

notesPayableValue.description: Written promises to pay a stated sum at one or more specified dates in the future. Includes : Banker's acceptance

notesReceivableCurrentValue.description: Net amount representing the right to receive the principal amounts contained in written promissory notes. Usually it is a written promise from a client or customer to pay a definite amount of money on a specific future date that is within the normal operating cycle.

notesReceivableNonCurrentValue.description: Amount representing the right to receive the principal amounts contained in written promissory notes. Usually it is a written promise from a client or customer to pay a definite amount of money on a specific future date that is beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

notesReceivableValue.description: Right to receive the principal amount contained in a written promissory note; which is usually a written promise from a client or customer to pay a definite amount of money on a specific future date.

openingShareholdersFundsValue.description: Balance of shareholders' equity at the start of the period.

operatingLeaseAssetsValue.description: Short term operating leases that are used to acquire equipment.

otherAssetsValue.description: Other assets not categorized above. Includes: settlement balances and short position assets

otherCurrentAssetsValue.description: Other current assets not categorized above. Includes: Unclassified current assets; dividend and interest on shareholder equity; leasing (if no specific nature of the lease is provided; common in South America) Excludes: Leased assets to generate income (map to Other Inventories).

otherCurrentLiabilitiesValue.description: Other liabilities not categorized above that are due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

otherCurrentPortionOfLongTermDebtValue.description: Carrying value of other long term debt not categorized above and due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

otherDeferredLiabilitiesCurrentValue.description: Other deferred liabilities not categorized above that will be recognized within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

otherDeferredLiabilitiesNonCurrentValue.description: Other deferred liabilities not categorized above.

otherDepositsValue.description: Other deposit liabilities not categorized above.

otherEmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesCurrentVa.description: Other long term employee related liabilities not categorized above.

otherEmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesNonCurren.description: Other long term employee related liabilities not categorized above.

otherEmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesValue.description: Other employee-related liabilities not categorized above.

otherEquipmentValue.description: Cost of other equipment owned by the company for its business operations; not categorized in the above. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

otherEquityInterestValue.description: Other equity attributable to parent stockholders not categorized above.

otherFinancialAssetsNonCurrentValue.description: Other financial assets not categorized above.

otherFinancialAssetsValue.description: Other financial assets not categorized above.

otherFinancialLiabilitiesCurrentValue.description: Other financial liabilities not categorized above.

otherFinancialLiabilitiesNonCurrentValue.description: Other financial liabilities not categorized above.

otherFinancialLiabilitiesValue.description: Other financial liabilities not categorized above.

otherGainsAndLossesValue.description: Other gains and losses not recognized in the Income Statement and not categorized above.

otherInsuranceBusinessAssetsValue.description: Other insurance business assets not categorized above.

otherInsuranceContractAssetsValue.description: Other insurance contract assets not categorized above.

otherInsuranceLiabilitiesReservesValue.description: Other insurance liabilities or reserves not categorized above.

otherIntangibleAssetsValue.description: Other intangibles not categorized in the above. Includes: Net book value if accumulated amortization is not reported; Club membership

otherInventoriesValue.description: All other inventories; not categorized above.

otherLoansBorrowingsValue.description: Agreements in which money is given to another party in exchange for future repayment of the principal amount plus interest and/or other finance charges. These could be for a specific one time amount or open ended credit up to a specified amount.

otherLoansCurrentDebtValue.description: Other debt not categorized above that is due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

otherLoansNonCurrentValue.description: Other long term loans not categorized above.

otherNonCurrentAssetsValue.description: Other non-current assets not categorized above. Includes: Other participating interests; dividend and interest on shareholders equity; leasing (if no specific nature of the lease is provided; common in South America). Excludes: Leased assets used to generate income (Leased Property; Plant and Equipment).

otherNonCurrentLiabilitiesValue.description: Other non-current liabilities not categorized above. Includes: Estimate Liability

otherNonEquityValue.description: Non-equity means someone owes you money with a note and mortgage or other security instrument securing the debt. Any security other than a stock. Examples include bonds and options. Non-equity securities may fluctuate in value in relation to stocks. For example; futures contracts may increase in price as stocks increase; while bond prices tend to move inversely to stock prices. The data point is available only for UK companies with London Stock Exchange listings.

otherPartnersCapitalValue.description: Other partner capital not categorized above.

otherPayableCurrentValue.description: Other payables not categorized above that are due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer). Includes: Salaries and Commission Payable; Authorizations/License of Authorization Payable; Payment of Bills

otherPayablesNonCurrentValue.description: Other payables not categorized above. Includes: Authorizations payables; licenses of authorization

otherPayablesValue.description: Other payables not categorized above. Includes: payables due to other financial institutions

otherPropertiesAndImprovementsValue.description: Cost of other improvements associated with properties; not categorized above. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported; betterments. Excludes: Improvements not related with Properties (charged under its respective asset)

otherPropertyPlantAndEquipmentValue.description: Cost of other property; plant and equipment not categorized in the above. Includes: Nuclear fuel reported within PPE; Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

otherProvisionsCurrentValue.description: Other provisions not categorized above that are due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

otherProvisionsValue.description: Liabilities or obligations arising from the legal clauses of contracts that are unrelated to employee benefits.

otherRealEstateOwnedValue.description: Property owned by the bank but not directly related to its business.

otherReceivablesCurrentValue.description: Amount due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer); and not categorized in the above. Includes: rent receivable

otherReceivablesNonCurrentValue.description: Amount due beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer); and not categorized in the above. Includes: rent receivable

otherReceivablesValue.description: Amount due in relation to other receivables not categorized above.

otherReservesAccumulatedComprehensiveInc.description: Any reserve not categorized above. Includes: goodwill reserves; equity in associate entities reserves; legal; statutory reserve ;etc.

otherShortTermInvestmentsValue.description: Other short term investments not categorized above.

otherTaxPayableCurrentValue.description: Current liability account which reflects the amount of other taxes (besides income taxes) due to the federal; state; and local governments.

otherTransfersValue.description: Other transfers in the shareholders' equity statement not categorized above.

paidInCapitalValue.description: Sum of all paid-in capital; including common stock and preferred stock.

payablesAndAccruedExpensesCurrentValue.description: Sum of all payables owed and expenses accrued; due for payment within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

payablesAndAccruedExpensesNonCurrentValu.description: Sum of all payables owed and expenses accrued; due for payment beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

payablesAndAccruedExpensesValue.description: Total of all payables and accrued expenses.

payablesToBrokerDealersAndClearingOrgani.description: Liabilities that reflect the amount owed to brokers; including dealers and clearing organizations; for services received.

pensionAndOtherEmployeeBenefitsNonCurren.description: Recognition of an asset where pension fund assets exceed promised pension and other employee benefits. Including severance

pensionAndOtherPostRetirementBenefitPlan.description: Long term obligation by the company for future annuity payments of the employees. All pension liabilities should map to this pension specific data point. Includes: Retirement benefit obligations; Severance cost

Long term obligation by the company for future annuity payments of the employees. All pension liabilities should map to this pension specific data point. Includes: Retirement benefit obligations; Severance cost
Accumulated gains or losses from pension and other post retirement plans

pensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitPlan.description: Liabilities associated with pension plans and other postretirement benefit plans. Including Severance cost

pensionReserveValue.description: Change in pension reserves reported in the shareholders' equity statement.

perpetualDebtValue.description: Debt without a maturity date to pay or redeem principal and interest that is paid continually.

plantAndMachineryValue.description: Cost of plant; machinery and facilities owned by the company for its business operations. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

pledgedDepositsAtBanksValue.description: Deposits used as collateral to obtain loans.

policyBenefitsAndClaimsOutstandingReserv.description: Reserves set aside for future policy benefits; claims which have occurred but not yet settled and claims incurred but not reported (IBNR).

policyholderDepositFundValue.description: Amount deposited by policyholders under life insurance contracts.

policyLoansValue.description: Loans in which the collateral is the cash value of a person's life insurance policy.

preferredSecuritiesOutsideStockEquityVal.description: Preferred stock reported outside of the Shareholders Equity section. Includes: Trust Preferred Securities; Redeemable Preferred Stock and Non-controlling interest subject to put option.

preferredSharesNumberValue.description: Number of Preferred Shares issued as of the period ending date; including both outstanding and treasury preferred shares.

preferredSharesOutstandingValue.description: Number of Preferred Shares outstanding as of the period ending date.

preferredSharesTreasuryValue.description: Number of Preferred Treasury Shares as of the period ending date.

preferredStockValue.description: Class of shares in the company that has a claim prior to common shareholders on the earnings of the company and on the assets in the event of liquidation. Includes: convertible preferred stock; equity redeemable preferred stock; equity other preferred stock

preferredUnitValue.description: Carrying value of preferred units. Preferred units are senior to common units; but subordinate to bonds in terms of claim (or rights to their share of the assets of the company) and may have priority over common units upon liquidation in a partnership structure.

prepaymentsAndDepositsCurrentValue.description: Amount paid or used as security/collateral for business activities within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

prepaymentsNonCurrentValue.description: Amount paid for business activities for one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer) in advance of receiving them.

prepaymentsValue.description: Amount paid for expenses before they are actually incurred.

priorYearAdjustmentValue.description: Correction of prior period errors/adjustments in the current reporting period.

propertiesValue.description: Total gross book value of the company's land; buildings; and leasehold improvements. Includes: Net book value if accumulated depreciation is not reported

provisionForAssetRetirementObligationSit.description: Obligation due within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer) that is associated with the retirement of a tangible long-lived asset in which the method of settlement may be conditional on a future event; the occurrence of which may not be within the control of the company.

Legal obligation associated with the retirement of a tangible long-lived asset in which the method of settlement may be conditional on a future event; the occurrence of which may not be within the control of the company.

provisionForEmployeeBenefitsRelatedLiabi.description: Liabilities related to employee benefits; including postretirement benefit plans and other employee-related liabilities.

provisionForEmployeeEntitlementsCurrentV.description: Long term obligations from the legal clause of a employment contract. Includes: Employee benefits; related liabilities; disclosed in the non-current liabilities section of the Balance Sheet.

provisionForEmployeeEntitlementsNonCurre.description: Long term obligations from the legal clause of a employment contract. Includes: Employee benefits; related liabilities; disclosed in the non-current liabilities section of the Balance Sheet.

provisionForMineMaintenanceCurrentValue.description: Current obligations/liabilities related to restoring a mine to its original state; processing and conditioning a closed mine site where there is potential to recommence operations; reclaiming or remediating land; or any other provisions specific to the mining industry.

provisionForMineMaintenanceNonCurrentVal.description: Long term obligations/liabilities due to processes and conditions on a closed mine site where there is potential to recommence operations.

provisionForTaxLiabilitiesCurrentValue.description: Provisions for tax-related liabilities that are expected to expire within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

provisionForTaxLiabilitiesNonCurrentValu.description: Provisions for tax-related liabilities that are expected to expire beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

provisionsCurrentValue.description: Sum of carrying values of long term obligations/liabilities from the legal clause of a contract that prohibits the company from performing certain actions beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

provisionsNonCurrentValue.description: Sum of carrying values of long term obligations/liabilities from the legal clause of a contract that prohibits the company from performing certain actions beyond one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

provisionsValue.description: Liabilities or obligations arising from the legal clauses of contracts that prohibit the company from performing certain actions.

purchasedGoodwillValue.description: Difference between the cost of an acquired entity and the aggregate of the fair value of that entity's identifiable assets and liabilities.

purchaseOfOwnSharesValue.description: Purchase of shares to increase treasury stock. Eventually decreases total net shareholders' equity.

rawMaterialsConsumablesAndSuppliesValue.description: Value of unprocessed items to be consumed in the manufacturing or production process. Includes: Purchased components

realEstateAndInvestmentPropertiesValue.description: Real estate held by property development companies as inventory.

receivablesValue.description: Amount owed to the company from other parties.

regulatoryAssetsCurrentValue.description: Specific costs or revenues that a regulatory agency permits the company to defer to its balance sheet.

regulatoryAssetsNonCurrentValue.description: Specific costs or Losses that a regulatory agency permits the company to defer to its balance sheet.

regulatoryLiabilitiesCurrentValue.description: Revenues/gains that a government agency permits a regulated utility to defer which will be recognized within one year or a normal operating cycle (whichever is longer).

regulatoryLiabilitiesNonCurrentValue.description: Revenues/gains that a government agency permits a regulated utility to defer under the non-current section of the Balance Sheet.

reinsuranceAssetsValue.description: All reinsurance related assets; including share of reinsurance contracts and reinsurance recoveries. Excludes: reinsurance receivables

reinsuranceLiabilitiesValue.description: Liabilities related to reinsurance; if reported separately by the insurance company. This includes estimated policy benefits; claims and losses due to reinsurance contracts.

reportPeriodLength.description: Indicates number of period length reported by the company: for instance; 12-month annual report has report period length as 12.

reportPeriodLengthType.description: Indicates unit of period length reported by the company: for instance; 12-month annual report has report period length type as months. General period length types include days; weeks; months and quarters.

reportRawEndDate.description: The actual report date when the company reports its financial statements

researchAndDevelopmentValue.description: Activities in connection with corporate innovation that have value and future economic benefit to the company. Includes: Net book value if accumulated amortization is not reported

reservesAccumulatedComprehensiveIncomeLo.description: Sum of all reserves that are derived from contributions by shareholders; profit; retained earnings; etc. in a Limited Partnership.
Sum of all reserves that are derived from contributions by shareholders; profit; retained earnings; etc.

reservesForBenefitsClaimsAndLossesExpens.description: Sum of insurance contract liabilities/reserves and investment contract liabilities.

residentOrTenantOrSecurityDepositsValue.description: Resident Or Tenant Or Security Deposits Value

restrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsValue.description: Carrying amount of Cash; Cash Equivalents and Investments items which are restricted as to withdrawal or usage. E.g. Restricted deposits; Judicial; pledge deposit; restricted investment; etc.

restrictedCashAndInvestmentsValue.description: Carrying value of cash; cash equivalent items; and investments which are restricted as to withdrawal or usage.

restrictedCommonStockValue.description: Common shares that are non-transferable and have some form of vesting period over a couple of years. They're primarily used for executives.

restrictedInvestmentsValue.description: Carrying value of investments which are restricted as to withdrawal or usage.

retainedEarningsAccumulatedDeficitLimite.description: Accumulated after tax earnings of the Limited Partnership company that have not been distributed to shareholders as dividends or allocated to any specific reserve account.

retainedEarningsAccumulatedDeficitValue.description: Accumulated after-tax earnings of the company that have not been distributed to shareholders as dividends or allocated to any specific reserve account.

retainedProfitLossForThePeriodValue.description: Profit or loss attributable to shareholders during the period as reported in the Income Statement.

retainedProfitsAtBeginningOfPeriodValue.description: Value of retained earnings carried forward from prior period Balance Sheet.

retainedProfitsAtEndOfPeriodValue.description: Net value of all above items ( accumulated profit from previous period + current net result after tax +/- movements in reserves or provisions - distributions).

revaluationsValue.description: Revaluation gains and losses recognized during the period outside the Income Statement/changes in equity resulting from revaluation of noncurrent tangible and financial assets.

revenueReserveClosedEndFundSupplementalV.description: Amount reserved out of retained earnings or profits retained by the company.

securitiesBorrowedValue.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of securities borrowed from broker-dealers or institutions.

securitiesLendingCollateralValue.description: Collateral held by the company in exchange for lending out securities to other parties.

securitiesLoanedValue.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of securities loaned to other broker dealers; typically used by such parties to cover short sales; which are secured by cash or other securities until the borrowing is closed.
