costOfGoodsAndServicesValue.description: Cost of goods and services sold reported by the company. Includes- Raw materials purchased for production ; cost of services; cost of goods manufactured; cost of sales/ product sold

costOfRevenueSupplementalValue.description: Sum of direct material and labor costs incurred in production of finished goods or services that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

costOfRevenueValue.description: Costs incurred to provide the goods or services that generate revenue for the company.

creditCardFeesValue.description: Revenue generated from credit cards fees.

currentTaxValue.description: Taxes on income that have been expensed during the period.

custodianFeesValue.description: Fees paid for the custody service of investment assets during the reporting period; including depository fees.

debtRestructuringSupplementalValue.description: Costs associated with negotiating with bankers; creditors; vendors; and tax authorities while restructuring the company's debt in order to restore liquidity and continue its operations that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

debtRestructuringValue.description: Costs associated with negotiating with bankers; creditors; vendors; and tax authorities while restructuring company's debt in order to restore liquidity and continue its operations; recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

deferredPolicyAcquisitionAmortizationExp.description: Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC) represents the 'un-recovered investment' in the policies issued and are therefore capitalized as an intangible asset to match costs with related revenues.

deferredTaxValue.description: Deferred taxes that have been expensed during the period.

depletionSupplementalValue.description: Allocation of the costs for natural resources; such as oil and mineral deposits; that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

depletionValue.description: Cost allocation for natural resources such as oil and mineral deposits.

depositInsurancePremiumExpenseValue.description: Expenses paid by the bank for deposit insurance.

depreciationAmortizationAndDepletionSupp.description: Non-cash expenses for use and obsolescence of assets; charged by allocating the cost of the depreciable assets; intangible assets; or natural resources to the accounting periods during its expected useful life; that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree. Includes: amortization of leased property; intangibles; goodwill; depletion

depreciationAmortizationAndDepletionValu.description: Non-cash expense to account for use and obsolescence of assets. Charged by allocating the cost of depreciable assets; intangible assets; or natural resources to the accounting periods of its expected useful life. Includes: amortization of leased property; intangibles; goodwill; and depletion

depreciationAmortizationCostOfRevenueVal.description: Charges for depreciation and amortization on assets directly related to revenue generation; hence forming part of cost of revenue. Common for airlines.

depreciationAndAmortizationSupplementalV.description: Sum of depreciation and amortization that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

depreciationAndAmortizationValue.description: Sum of depreciation and amortization expenses.

depreciationSupplementalValue.description: Allocation of the costs of depreciable assets to the accounting period that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

depreciationValue.description: Costs of depreciable assets allocated to the accounting period covered by the Income Statement.

dilutedNetIncomeAvailableToCommonStockho.description: Net income or loss available to common stockholders after dilution adjustment.

dilutionToEarningsValue.description: Effect on net income of the company from assuming the conversion of all convertible preferred stock; options; warrants; and convertible debt issued.

directorAndTrusteeFeesValue.description: Fees paid to directors and trustees.

directorsRemunerationSupplementalValue.description: Costs for remuneration paid to directors that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

directorsRemunerationValue.description: Costs for remuneration paid to directors.

discontinuedOperationsPreTaxValue.description: Operating income or loss made by the business segment(s) the company discontinued during the accounting period; recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

discontinuedOperationsSupplementalValue.description: Operating income or loss made by the business segment(s) the company discontinued during the accounting period that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

discontinuedOperationsValue.description: After-tax income or loss resulting from the discontinued segment(s) or division(s). Includes: gain or loss from disposal of discontinued operations

disposalOfBusinessesSupplementalValue.description: Net gain or loss from disposal or sale of businesses during the accounting period that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

disposalOfBusinessesValue.description: Net gain or loss from disposal or sale of businesses/participating interest; Associates; Joint Ventures during the accounting period recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

disposalOfDiscontinuedOperationsValue.description: After-tax gain or loss resulting from sale or disposal of discontinued segment(s) or division(s).

distributionsToPreferStockholdersFromNet.description: Amount of preferred dividends from net investment income declared or paid during the period. Includes: non-convertible preferred stock dividends; convertible preferred stock dividends; auction preferred shares

Amount of preferred dividends from net realized gains declared or paid during the period. Includes: non-convertible preferred stock dividends; convertible preferred stock dividends; auction preferred shares

dividendsAndInvestmentIncomeSupplemental.description: Income received in the form of dividends on investment in securities that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

dividendsAndInvestmentIncomeValue.description: Income received in the form of dividends from investment in securities reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

dividendsFeesValue.description: Fees paid for dividend distribution services.

documentFormType.description: The type of document filed by the company: for instance; 10-K (annual report) or 10-Q (quarterly report)

documentId.description: Morningstar Document Id; a unique and unchanging Morningstar identifier assigned to each document

domesticTaxValue.description: Taxes due to the government of the country where the company is domiciled.

doubleTaxReliefValue.description: Income tax relief given to companies to avoid paying taxes in two or more jurisdictions on the same declared income.

earningsFromEquityInterestPostTaxValue.description: Portion of income or loss of the subsidiary whose financial accounts are not consolidated with the parent or holding or controlling company. Includes: revaluation of previously held interest

equipmentExpenseValue.description: Expenditures related to equipment; such as repair; rental; and service contract costs.

equipmentHireSupplementalValue.description: Costs incurred towards hiring or leasing of equipment by the company during the year that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

equipmentHireValue.description: Costs incurred for hiring or leasing equipment during the period.

exciseTaxesValue.description: Taxes paid by the company that are directly associated with sales or services including excise duties

expensesOnInvestmentContractValue.description: Sum of investment contract liabilities incurred; reinsurance recoveries from investment contracts; policyholder interest; and bonuses and dividends paid to policyholders.

expensesOnReportsToShareholdersInvestors.description: Expenses related to providing reports to investors; such as annual meeting expenses and proxy document expenses.

explorationExpensesSupplementalValue.description: Costs incurred by the company to conduct feasibility studies for new wells that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree. Includes: mine development expenses

explorationExpensesValue.description: Costs incurred by the company for feasibility studies for new wells. Includes: mine development expenses

extraordinaryItemsValue.description: Carrying value of all non-recurring; special; or exceptional one time events that have occurred during the accounting period. Reported after income tax.

fairValueGainLossOnInvestmentPropertiesS.description: Net unrealized gain or loss due to changes in fair value of investment properties that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

fairValueGainLossOnInvestmentPropertiesV.description: Net unrealized gain or loss due to changes in fair value of investment properties recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

fairValueOrUnrealizedGainLossOnFinancial.description: Net unrealized gain or loss due to changes in fair value of financial assets that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.
Net unrealized gain or loss due to changes in fair value of financial assets recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

fairValueOrUnrealizedGainLossOnInvestmen.description: Gain/Loss charged to investments still held by the company due to change in market value.

feesAndCommissionExpenseValue.description: Expenses associated with generating fees and commission revenue; such as the expense for providing services.

feesAndCommissionIncomeValue.description: Revenue generated from the aggregate of service revenue; asset management fees; trust fees; brokerage commission revenue; credit card fees; and other fees/commission income. Includes: all transaction-based revenues

feesAndCommissionsExpenseSupplementalVal.description: Expenses associated with generating fees and commission revenue; such as the expense for providing services; that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

feesChargedByAdvisorOrManagerValue.description: Fees Charged By Advisor Or Manager Value

feesReceivedForAdvisoryOrManagementServi.description: Fees Received For Advisory Or Management Services Value

feeWaiversValue.description: Fees the company waives in order to keep the fund's net expenses low.

financeLeaseInterestExpenseValue.description: Finance lease interest expense from non-operating activities.

financialServicesCompensationSchemeClose.description: Amount paid to the UK's statutory fund to protect investors in case the investment company defaults. Reported in the capital column of the Income Statement.

fiscalYearEnd.description: The company's fiscal year that it uses to report its financial statements

foreclosedRealEstateExpenseValue.description: Expenses related Foreclosed assets. Includes foreclosed real estate Expense; other real estate owned (OREO) Expense; Owned Inactive Real Estates Expense; Idle properties expense and other foreclosed assets expense.

foreignTaxValue.description: Taxes due to the government of the country where the company is not domiciled but generates income.

gainLossOnDerivativesSupplementalValue.description: Net gain or loss on disposal or sale of derivative instruments that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

gainLossOnDerivativesValue.description: Net gain or loss due to changes in the fair value of derivative financial and hedging instruments reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

gainLossOnDisposalOfInvestmentProperties.description: Net gain or loss due to disposal of investment properties that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.
Net gain or loss due to disposal of investment properties recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

gainLossOnExtinguishmentOfDebtSupplement.description: Gain or loss resulting from paying off debt before it becomes due that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

gainLossOnExtinguishmentOfDebtValue.description: Gain or loss resulting from the issuer of debt recalling the debt before the scheduled maturity date and/or substantially modifying the existing terms of the debt.

gainLossOnForeignExchangeSupplementalVal.description: Net gain or loss due to fluctuations in exchange rates on foreign currency held during the period that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

gainLossOnForeignExchangeValue.description: Net gain or loss due to fluctuation in exchange rates on foreign currencies held during the period and reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

gainLossOnInvestmentPropertiesSupplement.description: Net gain or loss due to disposal or the fair value changes of investment properties that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

gainLossOnInvestmentPropertiesValue.description: Net gain or loss due to disposal or the fair value changes of investment properties recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

gainLossOnInvestmentsAndOtherFinancialIn.description: Net gain or loss on disposal or sale of investments; including financial instruments and other investments; that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.
Net gain or loss on disposal or sale of investments; including financial instruments and other investments; reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

gainLossOnInvestmentsFinancialInstrument.description: Net gain or loss on disposal or sale of investments; including financial instruments; derivatives; and other investments; that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

gainLossOnSaleOfCurrentAssetsSupplementa.description: Net gain or loss due to disposal or sale of current assets that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

gainLossOnSaleOfCurrentAssetsValue.description: Net gain or loss due to disposal or sale of current asset recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement

gainLossOnSaleOfFixedAssetsSupplementalV.description: Net gain or loss due to disposal or sale of fixed assets that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

gainLossOnSaleOfFixedAssetsValue.description: Net gain or loss due to disposal or sale of fixed assets recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement

gainLossOnSaleOfNonCurrentAssetsSuppleme.description: Net gain or loss due to disposal or sale of non-current assets (other than fixed assets) that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

gainLossOnSaleOfNonCurrentAssetsValue.description: Net gain or loss due to disposal or sale of non-current asset recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement other than Fixed asset

gainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssetsRevenueValue.description: Gain/Loss from selling other assets not categorized above; but in the ordinary course of the bank's business. Excludes: sales of investments; loans; investment properties; and real estate; one-time irregular asset sale (e.g. PPE). Includes: Foreclosed assets; Other real estate owned (OREO)

gainsLossOnDerivativesRevenueValue.description: Revenue associated with derivative transactions. Includes: both realized and unrealized gains/losses

generalAndAdministrativeExpensesSuppleme.description: Expenses that the company incurs not directly tied to a specific function such as manufacturing; production; or sales; that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

generalAndAdministrativeExpensesValue.description: Expenses that the company incurs that are not directly tied to a specific function such as manufacturing; production; or sales.

goodwillImpairmentWriteOffSupplementalVa.description: Amount of goodwill considered to be impaired or written-off during the accounting period that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

goodwillImpairmentWriteOffValue.description: Goodwill considered to be impaired or written off during the accounting period; recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

grossExpenseRatioValue.description: The Gross Expense Ratio represents the total gross expenses (net expenses with waivers added back in) divided by the fund's average net assets. If it is not equal to the net expense ratio; the gross expense ratio portrays the fund's expenses had the fund not waived a portion; or all; of its fees.

grossInterestSupplementalValue.description: Interest paid on borrowings during the year including interest capitalized; that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

grossInterestValue.description: Total amount of interest paid during the year reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement. Include: amortization of loans/debentures/bonds/discounts; pension interest; interest expense on derivatives; interest expense on taxes; interest expense on employee related liabilities; interest expense on payable; etc.

grossInvestmentIncomeClosedEndFundSupple.description: Amount of Gross Investment Income from the capital column of the Income Statement (particularly for UK investment companies).

grossPremiumsWrittenValue.description: Premiums to be collected as a result of insurance policies written during the period.

grossProfitValue.description: Difference between the total revenue and the sum of all direct costs incurred to generate the revenue.

impairmentOfFixedAssetInvestmentsSupplem.description: Loss due to impairment of long-term investments that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

impairmentOfFixedAssetInvestmentsValue.description: Loss due to impairment of long-term investments; recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

impairmentOfFixedAssetsSupplementalValue.description: Loss due to impairment of property; plant and equipment or any other long-term tangible fixed assets that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

impairmentOfFixedAssetsValue.description: Loss due to impairment of property; plant; and equipment or any other long-term tangible fixed asset; recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

impairmentOfIntangibleAssetsSupplemental.description: Loss due to impairment of intangible assets that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

impairmentOfIntangibleAssetsValue.description: Loss due to impairment of intangible assets; recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

impairmentReversalsOfInvestmentsRevenueV.description: Provision or impairments decrease a financial instrument's value to better reflect the current market value (loss); whereas reversals increase values previously impaired (gain).Includes: OTTI (Other than temporary impairment) losses. Except: Equity Method investment

impairmentWriteOffWriteDownOfCapitalAsse.description: Loss due to impairment; write-off; or write-down of capital assets (property; plant; and equipment and intangibles) that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

Loss due to impairment; write-off; or write-down of capital assets (property plant and equipment and intangibles; investment properties; biological Assets; Mineral Properties); recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

impairmentWriteOffWriteDownOfOtherAssets.description: Loss due to write-off or write-down of other assets recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement. Includes: write off/ reversal/ recovery of bad debt and doubtful accounts
Loss due to write-off or write-down of other assets recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement. Includes: write off/ reversal/ recovery of bad debt and doubtful accounts

incomeFromAssociatesJointVenturesAndOthe.description: Income or loss from investments in affiliated companies; joint ventures; and other participating interests accounted for through the equity method that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

Income or loss from investments in affiliated companies; joint ventures and other participating interests accounted for through the equity method and reported in non-operating section of the Income Statement. Includes: income from subsidiaries

incomeFromGrantsReceivedOperatingValue.description: Income from grants received reported in the operating section of the Income Statement.

incomeFromOtherParticipatingInterestsSup.description: Income or loss from investments in other participating interests accounted for through the equity method that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

incomeFromOtherParticipatingInterestsVal.description: Income or loss from investments in other participating interests accounted for through the equity method and reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

incomeTaxEffectOfOtherComprehensiveIncom.description: Effect on income taxes resulting from the items listed as other comprehensive income.

insuranceClaimsValue.description: Expenses incurred to pay claims from the bank's insurance business.

interestCapitalizedSupplementalValue.description: Allowance on borrowed funds used for long term projects or construction that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

interestCapitalizedValue.description: Allowance on borrowed funds used for long-term projects or construction; reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

interestExpenseClosedEndFundSupplemental.description: Interest Expense from the capital column of the Income Statement (particularly for UK investment companies).

interestExpenseCostOfRevenueValue.description: Total expenses from interest payments related to holding deposits; debt; capital lease obligations; repurchase agreements; and other activities.

interestExpenseForCentralBankFundsPurcha.description: Expenses associated with paying interest on funds purchased from the central bank and securities sold with the obligation to buy them back at a higher price on a later date.

interestExpenseForDebtAndCapitalLeaseObl.description: Expenses associated with paying interest on Debt and Capital Lease Obligations.

interestExpenseForDepositValue.description: Expenses associated with interest on holding deposits.

interestExpenseForFederalHomeLoanBankAnd.description: Expenses associated with paying interest on loans from the Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank.

interestExpenseForLongTermDebtAndCapital.description: Expenses associated with paying interest on long term debt and capital lease obligations.

interestExpenseForSecuritiesValue.description: Expenses associated with paying interest on  securities.

interestExpenseForShortTermDebtAndCapita.description: Expenses associated with paying interest on short term debt and capital lease obligations.

interestExpenseNetOfCapitalizedInterestS.description: Interest paid on borrowings during the year net of interest capitalized; that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

interestExpenseNetOfCapitalizedInterestV.description: Total amount of interest paid during the year; net of interest capitalized; reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

interestIncomeFromCentralBankFundsSoldAn.description: Revenue generated through interest on treasuries which the central bank will repurchase back over a period of time.

interestIncomeFromDepositsValue.description: Revenue generated through interest payments on deposits.

interestIncomeFromLeasesValue.description: Revenue generated through interest payments on lease arrangements.

interestIncomeFromLoansAndLeaseValue.description: Revenue generated from interest payments on loans and leases.

interestIncomeFromLoansValue.description: Revenue generated through interest payments on loans to customers and businesses.

interestIncomeFromSecuritiesValue.description: Revenue generated through interest payments from holding investment securities; trading account securities; and other money market investments.

interestIncomeRevenueValue.description: Total revenue from interest generated through loans/leases to customers; securities; deposits; repurchase agreements; and other sources.

interestIncomeSupplementalValue.description: Amount of interest received during the year that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

interestIncomeValue.description: Amount of interest received during the year; reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

investmentContractLiabilitiesIncurredVal.description: Investment contract liabilities consists of claims incurred in the year less the corresponding elimination of the policyholder liability originally recognized in the balance sheet and the investment return credited to policyholders.

irregularIncomeExpensesValue.description: Carrying value of all irregular; unusual; nonrecurring; special; or exceptional events that have either occurred or given effect during the accounting period reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

jointVentureExceptionalItemsSupplemental.description: Joint venture-related unusual expense or income that is unlikely to occur again in the normal course of business (such as joint venture disposals or impairments) that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

jointVentureExceptionalItemsValue.description: Joint venture-related unusual expenses or income that is unlikely to occur again in the normal course of business. For example; joint venture disposals or impairments. Recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

leaseRevenueFromJointVenturesValue.description: Lease Revenue From Joint Ventures Value

legalAccountingAuditingAndConsultingFees.description: Sum of all professional fees such as legal; accounting or consulting expenses incurred by the company due to external third parties for their services.

legalFeesSupplementalValue.description: Fees charged by external third parties for providing legal service to the company that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

legalFeesValue.description: Fees charged by external third parties for providing legal services to the company.

liquidityFeesValue.description: Fees paid to the company from the investors' redemption proceeds under certain conditions.

listingStockExchangeFeesValue.description: Fees paid to list shares on public stock exchanges.

litigationExpenseSupplementalValue.description: Expenses from a litigation settlement that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

litigationExpenseValue.description: Loss sustained through legal proceedings after settling controversies or disputes in a court of law. Recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

litigationIncomeExpenseSupplementalValue.description: Net gain or loss generated through legal methods for settling controversies or disputes or litigation that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

litigationIncomeExpenseValue.description: Net gain or loss generated through legal methods for settling controversies or disputes or litigation. Recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

litigationIncomeSupplementalValue.description: Income from a litigation settlement that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

litigationIncomeValue.description: Gain generated through legal proceedings after settling controversies or disputes in a court of law. Recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

longTermInterestExpenseValue.description: Long-term interest expense from non-operating activities.

managementResponsibleEntityFeesSupplemen.description: Fees paid by the company to its investment advisors for investment and portfolio management services that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

mergerAndAcquisitionIncomeExpenseSupplem.description: Costs incurred during merger and acquisition transactions that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree. Includes: demerger and spin-off expenses. Includes: negative goodwill; Bargain purchase

mergerAndAcquisitionIncomeExpenseValue.description: Costs incurred during the merger and acquisition transactions recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement. Includes: negative goodwill; Bargain purchase

mineralPropertyLeaseExpensesCostOfRevenu.description: Expenses to lease mineral property- producing mines during the accounting period.

netExpenseRatioValue.description: The percentage of fund assets used to pay for operating expenses and management fees; including 12b-1 fees; administrative fees; and all other asset-based costs incurred by the fund; except brokerage costs. Fund expenses are reflected in the fund's NAV. Sales charges are not included in the expense ratio.

netFeesAndCommissionIncomeValue.description: Fees and commission income less fees and commission expense.

netForeignExchangeGainLossRevenueValue.description: Gain/Loss due to changes in foreign currency exchange rates.

netIncomeAfterExtraordinaryItemsAndDisco.description: Net income of the company after accounting for extraordinary items and discontinued operations.

netIncomeAfterNonControllingMinorityInte.description: Net income; after accounting for non-controlling interests; reported in the comprehensive income table.
Net income or loss of the company after non-controlling interests attribution.

netIncomeAllocatedToCommonUnitholdersVal.description: Net income allocated to limited partners and subordinate unitholders.

netIncomeAllocatedToGeneralPartnerValue.description: Net income allocated to general partners.

netIncomeAllocatedToLimitedPartnerValue.description: Net income allocated to limited partners.

netIncomeAllocatedToSubordinateUnitholde.description: Net income allocated to subordinate unitholders.

netIncomeAttributableToTheCompanyLimited.description: Net income attributable to the Limited Partnership company.

netIncomeAvailableToCommonStockholdersVa.description: Net income available to common stockholders after accounting for all adjustments and preferred dividends.

netIncomeFromContinuingOperationsValue.description: Net income or loss of the company before giving effect to after-tax extraordinary items and discontinued operations.

netIncomeIncludingNonControllingInterest.description: Net income attributable to the Limited Partnership company; including the income attributable to the non-controlling interests.

netIncomeRatioValue.description: This ratio reveals the percentage of current income earned per share. The income ratio can be used as a gauge of how much of the total return comes from income.

netInterestIncomeExpenseSupplementalValu.description: Difference between total interest income and total interest expense that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

netInterestIncomeExpenseValue.description: Difference between total interest income and total interest expense reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

netInvestmentBankingIncomeValue.description: Revenue from wide range of investment banking services; esp. M&A; divestitures; restructuring; spin-offs; underwriting newly issued shares for clients; less the related expenses.

netInvestmentIncomeClosedEndFundSuppleme.description: Amount of Net Investment Income from the capital column of the Income Statement (particularly for UK investment companies).

netInvestmentIncomeRevenueValue.description: Net income on investments after adjusting for losses; impairment; and reversals.

netInvestmentIncomeSupplementalValue.description: Net realized gain or loss from investment assets such as bonds; stocks; mutual funds; loans; investments in affiliated companies; foreign exchange; and other investments that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

netInvestmentIncomeValue.description: Net realized gain or loss from investment assets such as bonds; stocks; mutual funds; loans; investments in affiliated companies; foreign exchange and other investments reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

netPremiumsEarnedValue.description: Net revenue from insurance premiums. Includes: net bank-owned life insurance income; gross premiums; and claims reported above operating expenses

netPremiumsWrittenValue.description: Gross premiums written less premiums ceded out.

netTradingIncomeRevenueValue.description: Aggregate revenue generated from trading investment instruments.

nonAuditFeesPaidToAuditorSupplementalVal.description: Fees paid to the auditor by the company for non-audit related services rendered that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

nonAuditFeesPaidToAuditorValue.description: Amount paid to the auditor for any non-audit related services rendered.

nonControllingInterestsLimitedPartnershi.description: Portion of net income attributable to non-controlling shareholders of a Limited Partnership company.

nonControllingMinorityInterestsValue.description: Carrying value of net worth of a subsidiary pertaining to common stock not owned by the controlling company and its consolidated subsidiaries.

nonInterestExpensesAndOtherIncomeValue.description: Sum of all non-interest expenses; income from participating interests; irregular income/expenses; and other income/expense that does not fit in any of the previous categories.

nonInterestExpensesValue.description: Sum of all regular expenses excluding interest expenses.

nonInterestIncomeValue.description: Total revenue less net interest income.

nonOperatingIncomeExpensesTotalValue.description: Aggregate value of all income and expenses not associated with normal business operations and recognized by the company in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

occupancyAndEquipmentExpenseSupplemental.description: Occupancy and equipment expenses that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

occupancyAndEquipmentExpenseValue.description: Sum of occupancy expense and equipment expense.

occupancyExpenseSupplementalValue.description: Usually disclosed as rental expenses or just as an occupancy expense that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree. Occupancy expenses consist of items such as property rentals; repairs and maintenance of property; utilities; land and other property taxes or levies. This category should be used for all companies with the exception of property trusts.

occupancyExpenseValue.description: Expenditures related to items such as depreciation of facilities; lease payments; property taxes; and property and casualty insurance.

ongoingChargeValue.description: A figure published annually by an investment company which shows the drag on performance caused by operational expenses. More specifically; it is the annual percentage reduction in shareholder returns as a result of recurring operational expenses assuming markets remain static and the portfolio is not traded.

operatingExpenseAsReportedSupplementalVa.description: Total operating expenses reported by the company on the face of the Income Statement.

operatingIncomeExpensesValue.description: Aggregate value of all income and expenses either directly associated with normal business operations or recognized by the company in the operating section of the Income Statement.

operatingLeaseExpenseSupplementalValue.description: Sum of all rent expenses incurred by the company for operating leases during the year that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

operatingLeaseExpenseValue.description: Expenses incurred by the company for operating leases during the year.

operationAndMaintenanceExpensesValue.description: Costs incurred for maintenance of assets such as inspecting; cleaning; adjusting; repairing etc.

operationMaintenanceAndRepairsValue.description: Expenses for the maintenance and repair of equipment directly related to revenue generation; hence forming part of cost of revenue. Common for Airlines.

organizationExpenseValue.description: Expenses from the organization and offering costs related to a newly established fund/trust.

otherAdjustmentsToNetIncomeAttributableT.description: Other adjustments to net income to arrive at net income of the Limited Partnership company not categorized above.

otherAdjustmentsToNetIncomeAvailableToCo.description: Other adjustments to net income to arrive at net income available to common stockholders not categorized above.

otherComprehensiveIncomeBeforeTaxValue.description: Total other comprehensive income or loss; before tax effect.

otherComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxValue.description: Total other comprehensive income or loss; net of tax.

otherConsultantProfessionalFeesValue.description: Fees paid for professional services; excluding legal; accounting and audit services.

otherCostOfRevenueValue.description: Other costs not categorized above that are directly related to revenue generation; hence forming part of cost of revenue.

otherDistributionsValue.description: Other adjustments related to stock dividends excluding participating preference stock

otherExpensesNonOperatingValue.description: Expenses from any other non-operating activity not categorized above.

otherExpensesOperatingValue.description: Expenses from any other activity associated with normal operations that are not categorized above.

otherExpensesSupplementalValue.description: Expenses from any other activity associated with normal operations that are not categorized as operating in nature and cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

otherExpensesValue.description: Expenses from any other activity associated with normal operations that are not categorized as operating in nature.

otherFeesAndCommissionIncomeValue.description: Other fees and commission income not categorized above. Includes: settlement and clearing fees

otherFeesOrExpensesChargedValue.description: Other Fees Or Expenses Charged Value

otherFeesOrExpensesReceivedValue.description: Other Fees Or Expenses Received Value

otherFeesValue.description: Other fees paid for investment operations.

otherFinanceExpensesValue.description: Total amount of other finance expenses incurred during the year reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement. Includes: amortization of deferred financing costs; amortization of debt issuance costs

otherFinanceIncomeExpensesValue.description: Difference between total other finance income and total other finance expenses reported in the non-operating section of Income Statement.

otherFinanceIncomeValue.description: Total amount of other finance income earned during the year reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

otherIncomeExpenseNonOperatingValue.description: Income or expenses from any other activity; not categorized above.

otherIncomeExpenseOperatingValue.description: Income or expenses from any other activity associated with normal operations that are not categorized above. Includes: amortization of deferred revenues/sales commissions/charges/ etc. as these are related to deferred or accrued operating income/expense

otherIncomeExpensesValue.description: Other income/expenses not categorized above. Includes: amortization of deferred revenues/sales commissions/charges/etc. as these are related to deferred or accrued income/expense

otherIncomeNonOperatingValue.description: Income from any other non-operating activity not categorized above.

otherIncomeOperatingValue.description: Income from any other activity associated with normal operations that are not categorized above. Includes: fees and commission income

otherIncomeSupplementalValue.description: Income from any other activity associated with normal operations not categorized above and that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree. Includes: fees and commission income

otherIncomeValue.description: Revenue from any other activity that are not categorized as operating in nature.

otherInsuranceExpensesValue.description: Other insurance expenses not categorized above.

otherInterestExpenseValue.description: Other interest expenses not categorized above.

otherInterestIncomeValue.description: Other interest revenue generated not categorized above.

otherInvestmentIncomeRevenueValue.description: Other investment related revenue not categorized above; includes investment expense.

otherInvestmentIncomeSupplementalValue.description: Gain or loss on any other investment not categorized above and that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

otherInvestmentIncomeValue.description: Gain or loss on any other investment not categorized above.

otherIrregularExpensesSupplementalValue.description: Costs incurred for any other non-recurring activity not categorized above that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

otherIrregularExpensesValue.description: Expenses from any other non-recurring activities not categorized above. Recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

otherIrregularIncomeExpensesSupplemental.description: Income or expense from any other non-recurring activity not categorized above that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree. Includes: acquired in-process research and development

otherIrregularIncomeExpensesValue.description: Income or expenses from any other non-recurring activities not categorized above. Recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement. Includes: acquired in-process research and development

otherIrregularIncomeSupplementalValue.description: Income from any other non-recurring activity not categorized above that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

otherIrregularIncomeValue.description: Income generated from any other non-recurring activities not categorized above. Recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

otherNetOfTaxesAdjustmentsValue.description: Other after-tax adjustments to net income not categorized above.

otherNonInterestExpensesValue.description: All other non-interest expenses not categorized above.

otherPartnerEquityLimitedPartnershipValu.description: Other partners' equity of a Limited Partnership company not categorized above.

otherProfessionalAccountingAndConsulting.description: Other accounting and consulting fees not categorized above and that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.
Other professional fees not categorized above. Includes : accounting fees and consulting fees.

otherProvisionExpenseWriteBackValue.description: Other provisions not categorized as provision for doubtful accounts.

otherProvisionsSupplementalValue.description: Provisions not categorized above that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

otherRealizedInvestmentIncomeRevenueValu.description: Realized gain/loss on other investment related activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

otherRentSupplementalValue.description: Other rental expenses incurred during the year on assets other than equipment and property; that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

otherRentValue.description: Other rental expenses incurred during the period not categorized above.

otherRevenueValue.description: Other revenue not categorized above. Includes: lease termination revenue

otherStaffCostsValue.description: Other staff costs not categorized above.

otherTaxValue.description: Other income tax expense not categorized above. Includes: recognition of additional deferred tax

otherUnderwritingExpensesValue.description: Other underwriting expenses not categorized above.

otherUnrealizedInvestmentIncomeRevenueVa.description: Unrealized gain/loss on other investment related activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

pensionAndOtherEmployeeBenefitsCostsSupp.description: Costs incurred for pensions; retirement; and other employee benefits that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree. Includes: provision for employee entitlements

pensionAndOtherEmployeeBenefitsCostsValu.description: Costs incurred related to pensions; retirement; and other employee benefits. Includes: provision for employee entitlements

performanceFeesValue.description: Agreed upon fees paid to the fund manager if the investment performance target was achieved or exceeded.

policyholderBenefitsAndClaimsGrossValue.description: Total provision in the period for future policy benefits; claims incurred and costs incurred in the claims settlement process before the effects of reinsurance arrangements.

policyholderBenefitsCededReinsuranceReco.description: Net amount in the period for future policy benefits and costs incurred under policies assumed and estimated recoupments under policies ceded.

policyholderFutureBenefitsAndClaimsNetVa.description: Provision for benefits; claims and claims settlement expenses incurred during the period net of the effects of contracts assumed and ceded.

policyholderInterestValue.description: Periodic income payment provided to the annuitant by the insurance company; which is determined by the assumed interest rate (AIR) and other factors.

portfolioTurnoverRatioValue.description: Measures the portfolio manager's trading activity by taking the lesser of purchases or sales (excluding all securities with maturities of less than one year) and dividing by average monthly net assets.

preferredDividendsPreTaxDistributionValu.description: Pretax value of dividends accrued; actual cash dividend payments; or provision for preferred dividends if in arrears on the company's preferred shares.

preferredGrossDividendsValue.description: Gross value of dividends that are accrued and paid to the company's preferred shares.

preferredInterestLimitedPartnershipValue.description: Portion of net income or loss of the Limited Partnership company attributable to preferred stockholders.

preferredOtherStockDistributionValue.description: Amount of dividends declared or paid during the accounting period to preferred or other shareholders.

preferredStockDividendsValue.description: Amount of dividends declared or paid during the accounting period to preferred shareholders includes non-convertible preferred stock dividends

premiumsCededOutValue.description: Premiums payable to another party in exchange for reinsurance.

pretaxIncomeValue.description: Income or loss generated during the accounting period before accounting for any federal; state or local taxes. Excludes: extraordinary items reported net of taxes

propertyExpensesAndHotelOperatingCostVal.description: Expenses paid to maintain properties or operate lodging services directly related to revenue generation; hence forming part of cost of revenue. Common for REITs and Real Estate firms.

propertyExpensesClosedEndFundSupplementa.description: Amount of Property Expenses from the capital column of the Income Statement (particularly for UK investment companies).

propertyOrAssetManagementFeesChargedValu.description: Property Or Asset Management Fees Charged Value

propertyOrAssetManagementFeesReceivedVal.description: Property Or Asset Management Fees Received Value

propertyRentSupplementalValue.description: Costs of occupying property during the period that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

propertyRentValue.description: Costs of occupying property during the period.

provisionAndImpairmentForLoanLossesAndCr.description: Losses and provisions that relate to loan defaults; credit risk and doubtful accounts (Account receivable; other receivable; Interest Receivable; and Trade receivable) Includes: provision for impairment of loans; write off/ reversal/ recovery /provision of bad debt and doubtful accounts and Provision and impairment of (Due from bank; Balances with bank; Interbank transaction; deposit; expected credit loss (ECL); off-balance sheet; Lease receivable; Loan commitment; financial guarantee contracts; acceptances and  commitments and guarantees)

provisionExpenseWriteBackValue.description: Sum of all provisions reported in operating expenses other than income tax; excise tax; or sales tax.

provisionForDoubtfulAccountsSupplemental.description: Amount of the current period expense charged against operations; the offset of which is generally the allowance for doubtful accounts for the purpose of reducing receivables; that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

provisionForDoubtfulAccountsValue.description: Amount recorded as expense in current period to account for possible uncollectable accounts receivable; trade Receivable and other Receivable.

provisionForIncomeTaxValue.description: Sum of all taxes on income earned. Expensed during the accounting period.

provisionsSupplementalValue.description: Sum of all provisions other than income tax; excise or sales tax; reported in the notes to consolidated statements that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

purchasedFuelPowerAndGasValue.description: Expenses for fuel; power; and gas directly related to revenue generation; hence forming part of cost of revenue. Common for Airlines.

realizedGainLossOnDerivativesRevenueValu.description: Realized gain/loss on derivative investment activity included in revenue during the reporting period. Excludes gain/loss on Foreign Currency Exchange.

realizedGainLossOnDerivativesValue.description: Net gain or loss due to derivative related transactions during the period.

realizedGainLossOnForeignCurrencyExchang.description: Realized gain/loss on Foreign Currency Exchange related activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

realizedGainLossOnForeignExchangeValue.description: Net amount of gains and losses related to foreign exchange recognized during the period.

realizedGainLossOnFuturesContractsValue.description: Realized gain/loss on futures contract investment activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

realizedGainLossOnInterestRateSwapContra.description: Realized gain/loss on interest rate swap contract investment activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

realizedGainLossOnInvestmentPropertiesRe.description: Realized gains or losses included in revenue as a result of investment property transactions.

realizedGainLossOnInvestmentSecuritiesRe.description: Realized gain/loss on investment securities included in revenue during the reporting period.

realizedGainLossOnInvestmentsRevenueValu.description: Capital gains/losses from selling securities held.

realizedGainLossOnOtherDerivativesValue.description: Realized gain/loss on other derivative investment activities not yet classified included in revenue during the reporting period.

realizedGainLossOnWrittenOptionsValue.description: Realized gain/loss on written option investment activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

realizedGainOnForeignCurrencyExchangeVal.description: Realized gain on Foreign Currency Exchange related activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

realizedLossOnForeignCurrencyExchangeVal.description: Realized loss on Foreign Currency Exchange related activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

registrationFeesValue.description: Filing fees incurred when registering with regulators or other governing bodies. Includes Blue Sky fees or other regulatory expenses as reported in the annual report.

reinsuranceRecoveriesChangeInInsuranceLi.description: Amount received from Reinsurer related to provision of insurance liabilities.

reinsuranceRecoveriesInvestmentContractV.description: Amount received from Reinsurer related to investment contract liability.

rentalIncomeRevenueValue.description: Income generated from rental assets; such as office space owned by the company and leased to another party.

rentalIncomeSupplementalValue.description: Income earned from leasing out properties; such as commercial spaces; to third parties; that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

rentalIncomeValue.description: Income earned from leasing out properties; such as commercial spaces; to third parties; recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

rentalRevenueValue.description: Operating revenue generated from rental assets.

rentAndLandingFeesCostOfRevenueValue.description: Expenses paid to use the facilities directly related to revenue generation; hence forming part of cost of revenue. Commonly used for retail; restaurants; airlines; and real estate companies.

rentExpenseSupplementalValue.description: Rent expenses incurred by the company for operating leases during the year; that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree. Includes: landing fees

rentExpenseValue.description: Expenses incurred by the company for operating leases during the year. Includes: equipment hire; property rent; other rent; landing.

reportedEffectiveTaxRateValue.description: The average tax rate for the period as reported by the company; may be the same or not the same as Morningstar's standardized definition

reportedNetInvestmentIncomeValue.description: Amount of Net Investment Income as reported by the company.

reportedNonInterestExpenseValue.description: This is an expense that banking companies incur apart from interest expenses.

reportedNonInterestIncomeValue.description: Amount of non-interest income as reported by the company.

reportedNormalizedEbitdaValue.description: Reported Normalized EBITDA represents earnings before interest and taxes; and depreciation & amortization adjusted for items that are irregular or unusual in nature; and/or are non-recurring as reported by the company.

reportedNormalizedEbitValue.description: Reported Normalized EBIT represents earnings before interest and taxes adjusted for items that are irregular or unusual in nature; and/or are non-recurring as reported by the company.

reportedNormalizedIncomeValue.description: Net income that is adjusted for the effects of seasonality and income/expenses that are unusual or one-time in nature reported by the company; usually in the notes to the financial statements or management discussion and analysis.

reportedNormalizedOperatingProfitValue.description: Reported Normalized Operating Profit represents Operating Profit net of irregular or unusual and non-recurring items as reported by the company.

reportedTaxEffectOfAssociateExceptionalI.description: Taxes on associate exceptional items reported by the company.

reportedTaxEffectOfDeferredTaxAssetAndLi.description: Deferred tax asset or liability reported by the company.

reportedTaxEffectOfExceptionalItemsForNo.description: Taxes on normalized exceptional items or changes in tax rates reported by the company.

reportedTaxEffectOfIrregularItemsValue.description: Total tax effect of irregular items reported by the company.

reportedTaxEffectOfMinorityExceptionalIt.description: Taxes on minority interest exceptional items reported by the company.

reportPeriodLength.description: Indicates number of period length reported by the company: for instance; 12-month annual report has report period length as 12.

reportPeriodLengthType.description: Indicates unit of period length reported by the company: for instance; 12-month annual report has report period length type as months. General period length types include days; weeks; months and quarters.

reportRawEndDate.description: The actual report date when the company reports its financial statements

researchAndDevelopmentExpensesSupplement.description: Costs incurred related to creating and developing new processes; applications; techniques; and products; that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

researchAndDevelopmentExpensesValue.description: Costs incurred for creating and developing new processes; applications; techniques and products.

restructuringAndReorganizationExpenseSup.description: Costs incurred in the process of restructuring or reorganizing for laying off employees or severance; closing manufacturing plants; shifting production to new locations; writing-off assets; etc. to improve the business and recover financially in the long-term. These costs cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree.

restructuringAndReorganizationIncomeExpe.description: Costs incurred in the process of restructuring and reorganizing for laying off employees or severance; closing manufacturing plants; shifting production to new location; writing-off assets; etc. to improve the business and recover financially in the long-term. Recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

restructuringExpenseValue.description: Costs incurred during the process of restructuring and reorganizing to lay-off employees; pay severance; close manufacturing plants; shift production to new locations; write-off assets; etc. to improve the business and recover financially in the long-term. Recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

royaltiesCostValue.description: Amount paid for using another party's patent or copyrighted material in the course of conducting activities directly related to revenue generation; hence forming part of cost of revenue.

saleOfInvestmentSecuritiesOfAffiliatedIs.description: Realized gain/loss from the sale of securities of affiliated issuers included in revenue during the reporting period.

saleOfInvestmentSecuritiesOfUnaffiliated.description: Realized gain/loss from the sale of securities of unaffiliated issuers included in revenue during the reporting period.

salesReturnAndAllowancesDiscountsValue.description: Reductions or adjustments to revenue due to customer returns; allowances; and discounts.

securitiesBrokerageCommissionRevenueValu.description: Revenue from commissions in the brokerage department. Includes: Brokerage fees

sellingAndMarketingExpensesSupplementalV.description: Sum of all costs incurred relating to the selling of merchandise that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree. Includes: picking; packing; warehousing; order charges; selling expenses; marketing expenses; distribution costs; commission expenses

sellingAndMarketingExpensesValue.description: Sum of all costs that enable selling of merchandise including picking; packing; warehousing; order charges; distribution; advertising; marketing and sales commission

sellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpensesS.description: Sum of all costs incurred relating to selling; general and administrative functions that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

sellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpensesV.description: Sum of all costs incurred relating to selling; general and administrative functions.

serviceRevenuesValue.description: Revenue generated from providing services to customers; such as monthly service charges.

shareOfDiscontinuedOperationsValue.description: After-tax income or loss of the segment(s) or division(s) of the company that have been discontinued.

shareOfProfitAndInterestFromAssociatesSu.description: Income or loss from investments in affiliated companies accounted for through the equity method that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

shareOfProfitAndInterestFromAssociatesVa.description: Income or loss from investments in affiliated companies accounted for through the equity method and reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

shareOfProfitAndInterestFromJointVenture.description: Income or loss from investments in joint ventures accounted for through the equity method that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.
Income or loss from investments in joint ventures accounted for through the equity method and reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

shortTermInterestExpenseValue.description: Short-term interest expense from non-operating activities.

socialSecurityCostsSupplementalValue.description: Costs incurred with respect to Social Security of the employees that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

socialSecurityCostsValue.description: Costs incurred with respect to Social Security of the employees.

specialGrossDividendsValue.description: Gross value of additional dividend payments made by the board to its shareholders that are separate from the normal recurring dividend cycle.

staffCostCostOfRevenueValue.description: Amount paid to employees in order to complete activities directly related to revenue generation; hence forming part of cost of revenue. Common for service-based companies like restaurants and airlines.

staffCostsValue.description: Sum of all costs incurred by the company relating to employees; officers; and directors. For example; remuneration or wages; stock based compensation; social security; pension; and other employee benefits.

stockBasedCompensationSupplementalValue.description: Costs incurred by the company for granting stock options to reward employees that cannot be broken out in the main Income Statement tree. Includes: share-based payments

stockBasedCompensationValue.description: Costs incurred by the company for granting stock options to reward employees. Includes: share based payments

subadvisorFeesValue.description: Fees paid to subadvisors for handling day-to-day management.

taxAttributableToPolicyholdersReturnsVal.description: Net of tax profit attributable to policyholders.

taxesCostOfRevenueValue.description: Taxes directly related to revenue generation; hence forming part of cost of revenue. Includes: all taxes in COR - production; property; sales; etc.

taxesOtherThanIncomeTaxesValue.description: Other operating taxes that are not related to income; excise; or sales levied on the revenue of the entity. Includes: production and severance taxes; operating tax and surcharges

taxOnFxAdjustmentsValue.description: Taxes on the foreign exchange adjustments made by the company.

totalExpensesValue.description: Costs incurred to provide the goods or services that generate revenue for the Entity.

totalGrossDividendsValue.description: Gross (before tax) amount of distributions to the company's shareholders.

totalNetFinanceIncomeExpenseValue.description: Difference between total interest and other finance income and total interest and other finance expense reported in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

totalNetIncomeAfterExtraordinaryItemsAnd.description: Total net income after extraordinary items and discontinued operations reported in the comprehensive income table.

totalOperatingExpensesClosedEndFundSuppl.description: Amount of total operating expenses from the capital column of the Income Statement (particularly for UK investment companies).

totalOperatingProfitLossAsReportedSupple.description: Total Operating Profit/Loss reported by the company on the face of the Income Statement.

totalOperatingProfitLossValue.description: Profit or loss realized by calculating the difference between sales and total operating expenses.

totalRevenueAsReportedSupplementalValue.description: Amount of gross revenue as reported by the company.

totalRevenueValue.description: Sum of all revenues or sales that the company can attribute to operational activities of the business less discounts; sales returns; and allowances.

trailCommissionsClosedEndFundSupplementa.description: Amount of Trail Commissions from the capital column of the Income Statement (particularly for UK investment companies).

transactionCostClosedEndFundSupplemental.description: Amount of transaction costs from the capital column of the Income Statement (particularly for UK investment companies).

transactionCostsValue.description: Fees paid for the purchase or sale of investments.

transferAgentFeesValue.description: Fees paid for transfer agent services; such as recording ownership of shares and processing dividends.

trustAndFiduciaryFeesValue.description: Revenue from transaction fees on trusts.

typeOfPeriod.description: Indicates the period type of financial statements. The period types include Discrete; Cumulative; Annual; TTM and Others. Discrete means a 3-month period for a quarter report and a 6-month period for a semi-annual report (SA1); Cumulative means a year-to-date period such as 6 months (Q2) and 9 months (Q3); Annual means a 12-month period; TTM means a derived trailing 12 months period;  Others is used for exceptional or unusual cases such as when a Fiscal Year End Change (FYC) occurs.

unadjustedRevenueValue.description: Revenue derived based on requirements from NASDAQ. For companies using the bank industry template; it is calculated using Net Interest Income; adding back interest expense to derive interest income revenue for the bank; and adding non-interest income to derive unadjusted revenue. For companies using the normal; insurance and investment templates; unadjusted revenue is the same as the company's total revenue.

unitOfReport.description: The unit that the company uses when reporting the values within its financial statements: for instance; 1000 for value reported in thousands.

unrealizedGainLossOnDerivativesRevenueVa.description: Unrealized gain/loss on derivative investment activity included in revenue during the reporting period. Excludes gain/loss on Foreign Currency Exchange.

unrealizedGainLossOnDerivativesValue.description: Net gain or loss due to changes in fair value of derivative financial and hedging instruments.

unrealizedGainLossOnForeignCurrencyExcha.description: Unrealized gain/loss on Foreign Currency Exchange related activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedGainLossOnForeignExchangeValue.description: Net amount of foreign exchange gains and losses due to translation to the functional/reporting currency.

unrealizedGainLossOnFuturesContractsValu.description: Unrealized gain/loss on futures contract investment activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedGainLossOnInterestRateSwapCont.description: Unrealized gain/loss on interest rate swap contract investment activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedGainLossOnInvestmentSecurities.description: Unrealized gain/loss on investment securities included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedGainLossOnOtherDerivativesValu.description: Unrealized gain/loss on other derivative investment activities not yet classified included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedGainLossOnWrittenOptionsValue.description: Unrealized gain/loss on written option investment activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedGainOnForeignCurrencyExchangeV.description: Unrealized gain on Foreign Currency Exchange related activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedGainOnInvestmentSecuritiesValu.description: Unrealized gain on investment securities included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedGainOnOtherDerivativesValue.description: Unrealized gain on other derivative investment activities not yet classified included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedLossOnForeignCurrencyExchangeV.description: Unrealized loss on Foreign Currency Exchange related activity included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedLossOnInvestmentSecuritiesValu.description: Unrealized loss on investment securities included in revenue during the reporting period.

unrealizedLossOnOtherDerivativesValue.description: Unrealized loss on other derivative investment activities not yet classified included in revenue during the reporting period.

vatIrrecoverableRecoveredClosedEndFundSu.description: Amount of irrecoverable or recovered VAT from the capital column of the Income Statement (particularly for UK investment companies).

wagesAndSalariesValue.description: Costs incurred relating to payment of wages or salaries to employees or officers of the company.

writeDownFixedAssetsSupplementalValue.description: Loss due to write-downs of fixed assets that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

writeDownFixedAssetsValue.description: Loss due to write-down of fixed assets recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

writeDownIntangibleAssetsSupplementalVal.description: Loss due to write-downs of intangible assets that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

writeDownIntangibleAssetsValue.description: Loss due to write-down of intangible assets recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

writeDownOtherAssetsValue.description: Loss due to write-down of assets recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

writeDownSupplementalValue.description: Loss due to write-downs of assets that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

writeOffBadDebtsSupplementalValue.description: Loss due to write-offs of bad debts that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

writeOffBadDebtsValue.description: Loss due to write off of bad debts recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

writeOffFixedAssetsSupplementalValue.description: Loss due to write-offs of fixed assets that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

writeOffFixedAssetsValue.description: Loss due to write-off of fixed assets recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

writeOffIntangibleAssetsSupplementalValu.description: Loss due to write-offs of intangible assets that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

writeOffIntangibleAssetsValue.description: Loss due to write off of intangible assets recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

writeOffOtherAssetsValue.description: Loss due to write-off of assets recognized in the non-operating section of the Income Statement.

writeOffSupplementalValue.description: Loss due to write-offs of other assets that cannot be classified in the main Income Statement tree.

reportPeriodEndDate.description: The standardized report date when the company reports its financial statements. Standardized report date will be either 28 or 29 (February); 30 or 31.

assetDisposalsAdjustment.description: This data point represents net gain or loss due to disposal or sale of assets reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

costOfRevenueAndOperatingExpense.description: This data point represents the cost and expenses associated with a company's operating business. This can be used to measure the funds the company has devoted to generating revenue. This is calculated using Cost of Revenue + Operating Income/Expenses - Income from Grants Received; Operating - Other Income; Operating.

debtRestructuringAdjustment.description: This data point represents the costs incurred from negotiating with bankers; creditors; vendors; and tax authorities while restructuring the company's debt in order to restore liquidity and continue its operations. This is reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

depreciationAmortizationAndDepletionCalc.description: This data point represents the calculated variant of depreciation; amortization and depletion. This is calculated by summing up all Depreciation; Amortization and Depletion reported by the company.

derivativesUnrealizedGainsLosses.description: This data point represents net gain or loss due to changes in the fair value of derivative financial and hedging instruments reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's total unusal items calculation.

discontinuedOperationsAdjustment.description: This data point represents net income or loss from disposal of discontinued operations reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

disposalOfBusinessesAdjustment.description: This data point represents net gain or loss from disposal or sale of businesses reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

financialAssetsUnrealizedGainsLosses.description: This data point represents net unrealized gain or loss due to changes in the fair value of financial assets reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's total unusal items calculation.

financialInstrumentsAndInvestmentsGainsL.description: This data point represents net gain or loss on disposal or sale of investments; including financial instruments and other investments reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's total unusal items calculation.

foreignCurrencyExchangeUnrealizedGainsLo.description: This data point represents net amount of foreign exchange gains and losses due to translation to the functional/reporting currency reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's total unusal items calculation.

gainLossOnExtinguishmentOfDebtAdjustment.description: This data point represents the gain or loss resulting from the debt issuer recalling the debt before the scheduled maturity date; and/or substantially modifying the existing terms of the debt. This is reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

goodwillImpairmentWriteOffAdjustment.description: This data point represents the goodwill impairment/write-off value reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

grossRevenueForBank.description: Sum of interest and non-interest revenues generated by banking companies. Non-interest revenue includes fees and commissions; net premium earned; investment income; net investment banking income; rental income; gain/loss on sale of assets and other revenue. The data point excludes interest expenses and fees and commission expenses.

impairmentWriteOffWriteDownOfCapitalAsse.description: This data point represents the loss due to impairment; write-off; or write-down of capital assets (property plant and equipment and intangibles) reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

incomeAfterTaxes.description: This calculation represents the company's after-tax earnings for the period. The calculation differs from Net Income; because it excludes Earnings from Equity Interests. This is calculated using Pretax Income minus Provision for Income Tax.

interestAndDividendIncome.description: This calculation represents the summation of a company's interest; dividend and investment income. This can be used to measure a company's investing and financing performance. This is calculated using Interest Income + Dividend and Investment Income.

interestExpenseCalculated.description: This data point represents the calculated variant of interest expense. This is calculated by taking the Reported Interest Expense Net of capitalized interest if available; or Interest Expense net of Interest Income.

interestRate.description: This data point represents a company's implied cost of debt. This is calculated using interest expense reported in the income statement divided by a company's total debt from its balance sheet.

irregularIncomeExpenseCalculated.description: This data point represents the calculated variant of irregular income/expense. This is calculated by summing up all Irregular Income/Expense reported by the company.

litigationIncomeExpenseAdjustment.description: This data point represents the net gain or loss sustained through legal proceedings after settling controversies or disputes in a court of law. This is reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

mergerAndAcquisitionIncomeExpenseAdjustm.description: This data point represents the costs incurred during merger and acquisition transactions reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

netIncomeSelectionCalculated.description: This data point represents the calculated net income attributed to common stockholders. This is calculated by using Net Income from Continuing Operations; minus Non-Controlling/Minority Interests and Preferred/Other Stock Distribution.

netInterestIncomeExpenseCalculated.description: This data point represents the calculated variant of net Interest income/expense. This is calculated by using the most complete version of either reported Net Interest Income/Expense or Net Interest Income/Expense from supplemental information.

normalizedPretaxIncome.description: This represents income or loss generated during the accounting period before any federal; state or local taxes; and is adjusted for items that are irregular or unusual in nature; and/or are non-recurring. This is calculated by using Pretax Income plus/minus any tax affected unusual items; and is a measure of a company's profitability.

otherIrregularIncomeExpensesAdjustment.description: This data point represents income or expenses from any other non-recurring activities reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

realizedInvestmentGains.description: This data point represents the summation of realized investment gains on the company's assets. This is calculated using Gain/Loss on Disposal/Sale of Business + Gain/Loss on Disposal/Sale of Fixed Assets. For banking companies; this also includes Realized Gain/Loss on Sale of Loans and Lease.

restructuringAndReorganizationExpenseAdj.description: This data point represents costs incurred in the event of a restructuring and/or reorganization with the aim to improve the business operations and/or financial situation of the firm; examples include laying off employees; severance pay; closing manufacturing plants; shifting production to a new location; writing-off assets; and more. This is reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

stockBasedCompensation.description: This data point represents costs incurred for granting stock options to compensate employees reported in the income statement or cash flow statement and selected for a company's irregular income/expenses and total unusal items calculation.

taxEffectOfUnusualItems.description: This calculation represents the amount of tax charged on unusual items for the purposes of calculating Normalized Earnings. This is calculated using Total Unusual Items Excluding Goodwill multiplied by the Tax Rate.

taxRateCalculated.description: This data point represents the calculated variant of tax rate. This is calculated by taking either the Reported Effective Tax Rate or using Provision for Income Tax divided by Pretax Income or the Statutory Tax Rate for the company.

totalUnusualItems.description: This calculation represents the amount of all the irregular and non-recurring items reported by the company. This can be used to measure the company's profitability from normal; on going operations. This is calculated by summing all of the irregular and non-recurring items.

totalUnusualItemsAfterTax.description: This data point represents the subtotal of irregular and non-recurring items (after-tax) based on CPMS (Computerized Portfolio Management Services) methodology standards.
